```{r, Script 1}
.assert_present <- function(nms, what) {
  missing <- nms[!vapply(nms, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(missing))
    stop(sprintf("[setup] Missing %s (expected from your prep scripts, run them first): %s",
                 what, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
}

save_figure <- function(plot_obj, name, width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM, height_mm, dir = fig_dir) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
  pdf_path <- file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
  png_path <- file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".png"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(pdf_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width_mm, height = height_mm,
                  units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggplot2::ggsave(png_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width_mm, height = height_mm,
                  units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  cat(sprintf("  %s saved (%g x %g mm)\n    PDF: %s\n    PNG: %s\n",
              name, width_mm, height_mm, pdf_path, png_path))
}


# ── S5. ONE matrix loader (colname-safe, fails loudly) ───────────────────────────────

load_matrix <- function(path, key = "Genes") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop(sprintf("[load_matrix] File not found: %s", path))
  m <- data.table::fread(path, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  if (!(key %in% colnames(m)))
    stop(sprintf("[load_matrix] Key column '%s' not found in %s (first columns: %s ...)",
                 key, basename(path), paste(utils::head(colnames(m), 3), collapse = ", ")))
  rownames(m) <- m[[key]]
  m[[key]] <- NULL
  mat <- as.matrix(m)
  stopifnot(nrow(mat) > 0, ncol(mat) > 0)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "double"          # guarantee numeric matrix regardless of fread typing
  mat
}

## S9.1  Seurat layer/slot accessor shim --------------------------------
get_rna_layer <- function(obj, layer, assay = "RNA") {
  tryCatch(
    SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = layer),
    error = function(e) SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, slot = layer)
  )
}

## S9.2  Split-violin geom  ----------------------
GeomSplitViolin <- ggproto(
  "GeomSplitViolin", GeomViolin,
  draw_group = function(self, data, ..., draw_quantiles = NULL) {
    data <- transform(data,
                      xminv = x - violinwidth * (x - xmin),
                      xmaxv = x + violinwidth * (xmax - x))
    grp <- data[1, "group"]
    newdata <- plyr::arrange(
      transform(data, x = if (grp %% 2 == 1) xminv else xmaxv),
      if (grp %% 2 == 1) y else -y
    )
    newdata <- rbind(newdata[1, ], newdata,
                     newdata[nrow(newdata), ], newdata[1, ])
    newdata[c(1, nrow(newdata) - 1, nrow(newdata)), "x"] <- round(newdata[1, "x"])
    if (length(draw_quantiles) > 0 & !scales::zero_range(range(data$y))) {
      stopifnot(all(draw_quantiles >= 0), all(draw_quantiles <= 1))
      quantiles <- ggplot2:::create_quantile_segment_frame(data, draw_quantiles)
      aesthetics <- data[rep(1, nrow(quantiles)),
                         setdiff(names(data), c("x", "y")), drop = FALSE]
      aesthetics$alpha <- rep(1, nrow(quantiles))
      both <- cbind(quantiles, aesthetics)
      quantile_grob <- GeomPath$draw_panel(both, ...)
      ggplot2:::ggname("geom_split_violin",
                       grid::grobTree(GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, ...),
                                      quantile_grob))
    } else {
      ggplot2:::ggname("geom_split_violin",
                       GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, ...))
    }
  }
)

geom_split_violin <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "ydensity",
                              position = "identity", ..., draw_quantiles = NULL,
                              trim = TRUE, scale = "area", na.rm = FALSE,
                              show.legend = NA, inherit.aes = TRUE) {
  layer(
    data = data, mapping = mapping, stat = stat, geom = GeomSplitViolin,
    position = position, show.legend = show.legend, inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
    params = list(trim = trim, scale = scale, draw_quantiles = draw_quantiles,
                  na.rm = na.rm, ...)
  )
}

## S9.3  Peptide split-half reliability (used by SF3 and MF2) ----------------------------
# Randomized when n_pep > 2; deterministic when n_pep == 2. Pass seed = NULL and set
# the seed once at the calling site (both sections do) so a batch of genes is reproducible.
split_half_reliability <- function(gene, pep_to_gene, pep_mat, cell_celltype,
                                   cell_type_order, peptides_pass_filter = NULL,
                                   n_iter = 100, method = "pearson", seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  peptides <- pep_to_gene$Stripped.Sequence[pep_to_gene$Genes == gene]
  peptides <- intersect(peptides, rownames(pep_mat))
  if (!is.null(peptides_pass_filter)) peptides <- intersect(peptides, peptides_pass_filter)

  n_pep <- length(peptides)
  if (n_pep < 2) return(NULL)

  pep_sub <- pep_mat[peptides, , drop = FALSE]
  ct_means <- sapply(cell_type_order, function(ct) {
    cells_in_ct <- which(cell_celltype == ct)
    rowMeans(pep_sub[, cells_in_ct, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  if (n_pep == 2) {
    cor_val <- suppressWarnings(cor(ct_means[1, ], ct_means[2, ],
                                    method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    return(data.frame(gene = gene, n_peptides = n_pep, iteration = 1, correlation = cor_val))
  }

  half_size <- floor(n_pep / 2)
  results <- numeric(n_iter)
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    idx_h1 <- sample(seq_len(n_pep), half_size)
    idx_h2 <- setdiff(seq_len(n_pep), idx_h1)
    h1_means <- colMeans(ct_means[idx_h1, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    h2_means <- colMeans(ct_means[idx_h2, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    results[i] <- suppressWarnings(cor(h1_means, h2_means,
                                       method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  }
  data.frame(gene = gene, n_peptides = n_pep,
             iteration = seq_len(n_iter), correlation = results)
}

## S9.4  Small annotation/format utilities
rank_na <- function(v) {
  r <- rep(NA_real_, length(v)); ok <- !is.na(v); r[ok] <- rank(v[ok]); r
}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "NA",
         ifelse(p < 1e-4, "< 1e-4", formatC(p, format = "g", digits = 2)))
}
spear_annot <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < 3) return(sprintf("n = %d", n))
  st <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))
  sprintf("\u03c1 = %.2f\np = %s\nn = %d", unname(st$estimate), fmt_p(st$p.value), n)
}
```

```{r, Script 2}
########################################################################################
## SCRIPT 2 / 8
##
## Assumes Script 1 (setup) has run: sc.batch_cor(.ab), pbmc.so, pbmc.prot,
## prot_celltypes, rna_celltypes, celltype_order/_colors, modality_colors,
## donor_colors, geom_split_violin, save_figure, figure_theme (8 pt) are all present.
##
## Session objects from UPSTREAM QC scripts (not built here):

##   SCP_ID_Depth_panel                  (Panel E)
## Helpers from your prep scripts: diann_load, diann_maxlfq, Normalize_saad.
########################################################################################

# ── Guard: setup + upstream panel objects must be present ────────────────────────────
local({
  need <- c("sc.batch_cor", "sc.batch_cor.ab", "pbmc.so", "pbmc.prot",
            "prot_celltypes", "rna_celltypes", "celltype_order", "celltype_colors",
            "modality_colors", "save_figure", "figure_theme", "geom_split_violin",
            "diann_load", "diann_maxlfq", "Normalize_saad",
            "sct.ica", "ICA_kNN_BatchCor_Norm", "SCT_Detection_Sensitivity",
            "SCP_ID_Depth_panel")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(miss))
    stop(sprintf("[MF1] Missing (run Script 1 setup and upstream QC scripts first): %s",
                 paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
})

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(ComplexHeatmap); library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(stringr)
  library(tibble); library(scales); library(patchwork); library(grid); library(png)
})


# ── V2. Bulk PBMC protein processing (feeds V7 / Panel I) ────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== V2. Bulk PBMC protein processing ===\n")

df.glob.full <- diann_load(
  "/projects/slavov/LK/ImmPTR/data/raw_data/bulk_protein/diann_b17/Bulk_R1_LibGen_Global/report.tsv"
)

df.glob <- df.glob.full %>%
  filter(
    Lib.Q.Value        <= 0.01,
    Lib.PG.Q.Value     <= 0.05,
    Ms1.Area            > 0,
    Precursor.Quantity  > 0,
    !grepl("GD", Run)   # remove extra donor used only for MBR
  )

CellTypeAssignments <- df.glob %>%
  dplyr::select(Run) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    CellType = case_when(
      str_detect(Run, "Bcell|BCell") ~ "B cells",
      str_detect(Run, "Mono")        ~ "Monocytes",
      str_detect(Run, "CD4")         ~ "CD4 T cells",
      str_detect(Run, "CD8")         ~ "CD8 T cells",
      str_detect(Run, "NK")          ~ "NK cells",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Donor = case_when(
      str_detect(Run, "P1") ~ "Donor05",
      str_detect(Run, "P2") ~ "Donor04",
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(RunNum = as.numeric(str_extract(Run, "\\d{4}$"))) %>%
  arrange(RunNum) %>%
  mutate(RunOrder = rank(RunNum, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  mutate(CellType_UniqueID = paste0(CellType, "_", RunOrder)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-RunNum)

df.glob <- df.glob %>% left_join(CellTypeAssignments, by = "Run")

df.filt_final <- df.glob %>%
  filter(Ms1.Area > 0) %>%
  group_by(CellType, Precursor.Id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Run[Ms1.Area > 0]) >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Precursor.Id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(CellType) >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()

prot.mat <- diann_maxlfq(
  df.filt_final,
  sample.header   = "CellType_UniqueID",
  group.header    = "Genes",
  id.header       = "Precursor.Id",
  quantity.header = "Ms1.Area"
)

prot.mat.log.norm <- Normalize_saad(prot.mat, log = "yes")

cat(sprintf("  Bulk: %d proteins x %d samples (post-norm)\n",
            nrow(prot.mat.log.norm), ncol(prot.mat.log.norm)))
cat("  Bulk samples per cell type:\n"); print(table(CellTypeAssignments$CellType))


# ── V3. Cell composition — MF1 Panel C only ──────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== V3. Cell composition (Panel C) ===\n")

prot_cell_counts <- prot_celltypes %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% names(celltype_colors)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(modality = "Protein", total = sum(n_cells), proportion = n_cells / total)

rna_cell_counts <- rna_celltypes %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% names(celltype_colors)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(modality = "mRNA", total = sum(n_cells), proportion = n_cells / total)

cell_counts_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(prot_cell_counts, rna_cell_counts) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_order),
                modality = factor(modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")))

axis_labels <- cell_counts_combined %>%
  dplyr::group_by(modality) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_cells = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pretty_label = paste0(modality, "\n(n = ", total_cells, ")")) %>%
  { setNames(.$pretty_label, .$modality) }

composition_theme <- theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 7.5),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 6.5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 6.5, vjust = 1.2),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    legend.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

p_pct_cells_by_modality <- ggplot(
  cell_counts_combined, aes(x = modality, y = proportion, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors, name = "Cell Type") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of Total Cells") +
  composition_theme

prot_avg <- sc.batch_cor %>%

cat("\n=== V6. Pairwise Jaccard index ===\n")

vectorized_pairwise_jaccard <- function(binary_matrix, modality_name) {
  n_cells <- ncol(binary_matrix); n_pairs <- n_cells * (n_cells - 1) / 2
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells, %s features, %s pairs\n", modality_name, n_cells,
              format(nrow(binary_matrix), big.mark = ","), format(n_pairs, big.mark = ",")))
  X <- as.matrix(binary_matrix) * 1.0
  inter       <- crossprod(X)
  feat_counts <- diag(inter)
  union_mat   <- outer(feat_counts, feat_counts, FUN = "+") - inter
  jaccard_mat <- inter / union_mat
  jaccard_mat[union_mat == 0] <- 0
  data.frame(jaccard = jaccard_mat[upper.tri(jaccard_mat)],
             modality = modality_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

prot_matrix_v6 <- as.matrix(sc.batch_cor)

bulk_fc_mat <- sapply(celltype_order, function(focal) {
  others <- setdiff(celltype_order, focal)
  bulk_avg_mat[, focal] - rowMeans(bulk_avg_mat[, others, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
})
colnames(bulk_fc_mat) <- celltype_order

set.seed(42)   # LOCAL — makes the V7 subsampling reproducible
n_iterations_v7 <- 100
subsample_frac_v7 <- 0.80

subsample_modality_v7 <- function(sc_mat, cell_labels, modality_name) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s subsampling...\n", modality_name))
  results <- vector("list", length(celltype_order))
  for (k in seq_along(celltype_order)) {
    focal_ct    <- celltype_order[k]
    focal_cells <- which(cell_labels == focal_ct)
    other_cells <- which(cell_labels != focal_ct)
    n_focal_sub <- round(length(focal_cells) * subsample_frac_v7)
    n_other_sub <- round(length(other_cells) * subsample_frac_v7)
    bulk_fc <- bulk_fc_mat[, focal_ct]
    r_vec <- numeric(n_iterations_v7)
    for (b in seq_len(n_iterations_v7)) {
      f_idx <- sample(focal_cells, n_focal_sub, replace = FALSE)
      o_idx <- sample(other_cells, n_other_sub, replace = FALSE)
      focal_mean <- rowMeans(sc_mat[, f_idx, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      other_mean <- rowMeans(sc_mat[, o_idx, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      sc_fc      <- focal_mean - other_mean
      valid <- is.finite(sc_fc) & is.finite(bulk_fc)
      r_vec[b] <- if (sum(valid) >= 10) cor(sc_fc[valid], bulk_fc[valid], method = "pearson") else NA_real_
    }
    results[[k]] <- data.frame(CellType = focal_ct, Iteration = seq_len(n_iterations_v7),
                               pearson_r = r_vec, Modality = modality_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("    %s: median r = %.3f  (n_focal = %d -> %d)\n",
                focal_ct, median(r_vec, na.rm = TRUE), length(focal_cells), n_focal_sub))
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(results)
}

prot_subsample <- subsample_modality_v7(scp_mat, prot_celltypes_v7$celltype, "Protein")

cat("  Subsampling summary (median r, 2.5-97.5 percentile):\n"); print(combined_summary)

subsample_filtered <- combined_subsample %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(combined_summary, by = c("CellType", "Modality")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(pearson_r >= lower_bound & pearson_r <= upper_bound)

endpoints <- combined_summary %>%

  dplyr::mutate(Iteration = -1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(CellType, Iteration, pearson_r, Modality) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(combined_summary, by = c("CellType", "Modality"))

subsample_filtered <- dplyr::bind_rows(subsample_filtered, endpoints) %>%

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Correlation to Bulk Protein FC\n(Cell type - All others)") +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, angle = 25, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = c(0.7, 0.90), legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.title = element_blank(),
```

```{r, Script 3}
      str_detect(Run, "NK")          ~ "NK cells",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_),
    Donor = case_when(str_detect(Run, "P1") ~ "Donor05",
                      str_detect(Run, "P2") ~ "Donor04", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  mutate(RunNum = as.numeric(str_extract(Run, "\\d{4}$"))) %>%
  arrange(RunNum) %>%
  mutate(RunOrder = rank(RunNum, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  mutate(CellType_UniqueID = paste0(CellType, "_", RunOrder)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-RunNum)

df.glob <- df.glob %>% left_join(CellTypeAssignments, by = "Run")
df.filt_final <- df.glob %>%
  filter(Ms1.Area > 0) %>%
  group_by(CellType, Precursor.Id) %>% filter(n_distinct(Run[Ms1.Area > 0]) >= 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Precursor.Id) %>% filter(n_distinct(CellType) >= 2) %>% ungroup()

                         quantity.header = "Ms1.Area")

  cat("  NOTE: mRNA is the limiting modality for at least one cell type (kept in full).\n")

# Fresh cell-count-matched draw, per cell type
draw_downsample_v10 <- function(meta, targets) {
  keep <- unlist(lapply(names(targets), function(ct) {
    pool <- meta$ID[meta$celltype == ct]
    if (length(pool) <= targets[[ct]]) pool else sample(pool, targets[[ct]])
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  meta[meta$ID %in% keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

cat(sprintf("  mRNA cells: %d available, %d used per bootstrap (genes: %d)\n",
            ncol(rna_data_full), sum(ds_target_v10), nrow(rna_data_full)))

filter_proteins_v10 <- function(prot_mat, meta, cts, floor = 0.05) {
  per_ct <- lapply(cts, function(ct) {
    cells <- intersect(meta$ID[meta$celltype == ct], colnames(prot_mat))
    if (length(cells) == 0) return(character(0))
    mat <- prot_mat[, cells, drop = FALSE]
    rownames(mat)[rowSums(!is.na(mat)) / ncol(mat) >= floor]
  })
  Reduce(base::intersect, per_ct)
}
filter_genes_mrna_v10 <- function(rna_mat, meta, cts, floor = 0.05, min_cells_abs = 3) {
  per_ct <- lapply(cts, function(ct) {
    cells <- intersect(meta$ID[meta$celltype == ct], colnames(rna_mat))
    if (length(cells) == 0) return(character(0))
    sub  <- rna_mat[, cells, drop = FALSE]
    thr  <- max(min_cells_abs, ceiling(floor * length(cells)))
    rownames(rna_mat)[Matrix::rowSums(sub > 0) >= thr]
  })
  Reduce(base::intersect, per_ct)
}

protein_set_5pct <- filter_proteins_v10(sc.batch_cor.ab, prot_meta_v10,

set.seed(20240517)

            length(intersect(mrna_set_detected, mrna_set_fulldepth))))

  set.seed(s)
  filter_genes_mrna_v10(rna_data_full, draw_downsample_v10(rna_meta_v10, ds_target_v10),
                        celltype_order, mrna_detection_floor_v10, mrna_min_cells_abs_v10)
})

            paste(lengths(mrna_sets_v10), collapse = ", "),
            length(Reduce(base::intersect, mrna_sets_v10))))

shared_geneproducts <- Reduce(base::intersect, list(
  protein_set_5pct, mrna_set_detected, rownames(sc.batch_cor), rownames(rna_data_full)))
cat(sprintf("  Protein set: %d | mRNA set: %d | SHARED: %d\n",
            length(protein_set_5pct), length(mrna_set_detected), length(shared_geneproducts)))
stopifnot(length(shared_geneproducts) >= 10)

rna_data_rel <- as.matrix(rna_data_full[shared_geneproducts, , drop = FALSE]) / log(2)
rna_data_rel <- rna_data_rel - rowMeans(rna_data_rel, na.rm = TRUE)

run_splithalf_v10 <- function(value_mat, meta, gene_set, modality_name, cts, n_bootstraps,
                              ds_targets = NULL) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  %s:\n", modality_name))
  if (length(gene_set) < 10) { cat("    SKIPPED (<10 genes).\n"); return(data.frame()) }
  mat <- as.matrix(value_mat[gene_set, meta$ID, drop = FALSE])
  if (is.null(ds_targets)) {
    ds_targets <- vapply(cts, function(ct) sum(meta$celltype == ct), integer(1))
    names(ds_targets) <- cts
  }
  results <- vector("list", length(cts))
  for (k in seq_along(cts)) {
    focal_ct  <- cts[k]
    other_cts <- setdiff(cts, focal_ct)
    if (ds_targets[[focal_ct]] < 4 || sum(ds_targets[other_cts]) < 4) {
      cat(sprintf("    %s: too few cells, skipped.\n", focal_ct)); next }
    r_vec <- numeric(n_bootstraps); rs_vec <- numeric(n_bootstraps)
    n_gene_vec <- integer(n_bootstraps)
    nf_vec <- integer(n_bootstraps); no_vec <- integer(n_bootstraps)
    for (b in seq_len(n_bootstraps)) {
      # fresh cell-count-matched draw
      meta_b      <- draw_downsample_v10(meta, ds_targets)
      focal_cells <- sample(meta_b$ID[meta_b$celltype == focal_ct])
      
      # stratified half-split of the "others" pool, per cell type: composition of the
      # reference mean is identical in both halves, and stays frequency-weighted
      oth <- meta_b[meta_b$celltype != focal_ct, , drop = FALSE]
      oh  <- lapply(split(oth$ID, oth$celltype), function(ids) {
        ids <- sample(ids); h <- floor(length(ids) / 2)
        list(A = ids[seq_len(h)], B = ids[(h + 1):length(ids)])
      })
      oA <- unlist(lapply(oh, `[[`, "A"), use.names = FALSE)
      oB <- unlist(lapply(oh, `[[`, "B"), use.names = FALSE)
      if (b == 1L && any(vapply(oh, function(x) length(x$A) == 0L, logical(1))))
        warning(sprintf("%s (%s): a non-focal stratum contributed 0 cells to half A",
                        focal_ct, modality_name), call. = FALSE)
      
      n_focal <- length(focal_cells); n_fh <- floor(n_focal / 2)
      fA <- focal_cells[seq_len(n_fh)]; fB <- focal_cells[(n_fh + 1):n_focal]
      n_other <- length(oA) + length(oB)
      nf_vec[b] <- n_focal; no_vec[b] <- n_other
      if (n_fh < 2 || length(oA) < 2 || length(oB) < 2) {
        r_vec[b] <- NA_real_; rs_vec[b] <- NA_real_; next }
      
      fc_A <- rowMeans(mat[, fA, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) - rowMeans(mat[, oA, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      fc_B <- rowMeans(mat[, fB, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) - rowMeans(mat[, oB, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      valid <- is.finite(fc_A) & is.finite(fc_B)
      n_gene_vec[b] <- sum(valid)
      if (sum(valid) >= 10) {
        r_vec[b]  <- cor(fc_A[valid], fc_B[valid], method = "pearson")
        rs_vec[b] <- cor(fc_A[valid], fc_B[valid], method = "spearman")
      } else { r_vec[b] <- NA_real_; rs_vec[b] <- NA_real_ }
    }
    results[[k]] <- data.frame(CellType = focal_ct, Bootstrap = seq_len(n_bootstraps),
                               n_genes = n_gene_vec, pearson_r = r_vec, spearman_r = rs_vec,
                               n_focal = nf_vec, n_other = no_vec,
                               Modality = modality_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("    %s: median r = %.3f (rho = %.3f; n_focal = %d, n_other = %d)\n",
                focal_ct, median(r_vec, na.rm = TRUE), median(rs_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                round(mean(nf_vec)), round(mean(no_vec))))
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(results)
}

set.seed(101)
protein_results_v10_rel <- run_splithalf_v10(sc.batch_cor, prot_meta_v10,
                                             shared_geneproducts, "Protein", celltype_order,
                                             n_bootstraps_v10, ds_targets = NULL)

  "Split-Half Correlation (Spearman)" else "Split-Half Correlation (Pearson)"

combined_results_v10_rel <- dplyr::bind_rows(protein_results_v10_rel, mrna_results_v10_rel) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(stat_r   = .data[[stat_to_plot_v10]],
                CellType = factor(CellType, levels = celltype_order),
                Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")))

combined_summary_v10_rel <- combined_results_v10_rel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CellType, Modality) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_r = median(stat_r, na.rm = TRUE),
                   lower_bound = quantile(stat_r, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                   upper_bound = quantile(stat_r, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

results_ci_filtered_v10_rel <- combined_results_v10_rel %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(combined_summary_v10_rel, by = c("CellType", "Modality")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_r >= lower_bound & stat_r <= upper_bound)
endpoints_v10_rel <- combined_summary_v10_rel %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(lower_bound, upper_bound), names_to = "which", values_to = "stat_r") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Bootstrap = -1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(CellType, Bootstrap, stat_r, Modality) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(combined_summary_v10_rel, by = c("CellType", "Modality"))
results_ci_filtered_v10_rel <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_ci_filtered_v10_rel, endpoints_v10_rel) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, levels = celltype_order),
                Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")))

combined_results_v10_rel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CellType, Modality) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pearson = median(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
                   spearman = median(spearman_r, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(digits = 3)

n_geneproducts_label <- formatC(length(shared_geneproducts), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
splithalf_violin_rel <- ggplot(results_ci_filtered_v10_rel,
                               aes(x = CellType, y = stat_r, fill = Modality)) +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = combined_summary_v10_rel,
                aes(x = CellType, ymin = lower_bound, ymax = upper_bound, group = Modality),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = combined_summary_v10_rel, aes(x = CellType, y = median_r, fill = Modality),
             position = position_dodge(0.8), size = 1.6, shape = 18, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 0.02, label = paste0(n_geneproducts_label, " gene-products"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 1.8, color = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = modality_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = stat_axis_label) +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, angle = 25, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(1, 0.1),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0), legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
cat("  Built: splithalf_violin_rel (SF1B_F)\n")



# ── V11. Donor 1 vs Donor 2 scatter, cytokines highlighted (SF1B_G) ──────────────────
cat("\n=== V11. Donor-donor scatter ===\n")

min_cells_per_group <- 3
cell_meta_v11 <- data.frame(ID = colnames(sc.batch_cor.ab),
                            celltype = as.character(pbmc.prot@active.ident)[
                              match(colnames(sc.batch_cor.ab), colnames(pbmc.prot))],
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    data.frame(ID = rownames(pbmc.prot@meta.data), donor = pbmc.prot@meta.data$sample,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(donor = dplyr::recode(donor, "Donor04" = "Donor 1", "Donor05" = "Donor 2")),
    by = "ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% celltype_order)

compute_group_means_v11 <- function(prot_mat, cell_meta, ct, dn, min_cells = 3) {
  grp_ids <- cell_meta$ID[cell_meta$celltype == ct & cell_meta$donor == dn]
  if (length(grp_ids) < min_cells) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(prot_mat)))
  sub <- prot_mat[, grp_ids, drop = FALSE]
  n_valid <- rowSums(!is.na(sub)); means <- rowMeans(sub, na.rm = TRUE)
  means[n_valid < min_cells] <- NA_real_; means
}
prot_names_v11 <- rownames(sc.batch_cor.ab)
per_group_means <- tidyr::expand_grid(celltype = celltype_order, donor = c("Donor 1", "Donor 2")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(means = purrr::map2(celltype, donor, function(ct, dn)
    compute_group_means_v11(sc.batch_cor.ab, cell_meta_v11, ct, dn, min_cells = min_cells_per_group)))

donor_tables <- lapply(celltype_order, function(ct) {
  d1 <- per_group_means$means[[which(per_group_means$celltype == ct & per_group_means$donor == "Donor 1")]]
  d2 <- per_group_means$means[[which(per_group_means$celltype == ct & per_group_means$donor == "Donor 2")]]
  data.frame(protein = prot_names_v11, Donor_1 = d1, Donor_2 = d2, celltype = ct, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Donor_1) & !is.na(Donor_2)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_cytokine = protein %in% cytokine_genes_v10)
})
combined_df_v11 <- dplyr::bind_rows(donor_tables) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_order))

cor_table_v11 <- combined_df_v11 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_all = dplyr::n(),
                   r_all = cor(Donor_1, Donor_2, method = "pearson"),
                   n_cytokine = sum(is_cytokine),
                   r_cytokine = if (sum(is_cytokine) >= 3)
                     cor(Donor_1[is_cytokine], Donor_2[is_cytokine], method = "pearson") else NA_real_,
                   .groups = "drop")
cat("  Donor-donor correlations per cell type:\n"); print(cor_table_v11)

cor_labels <- cor_table_v11 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = sprintf("All proteins: r = %.3f (n = %d)\nCytokines: r = %s (n = %d)",
                                r_all, n_all,
                                ifelse(is.na(r_cytokine), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", r_cytokine)), n_cytokine)) %>%
  dplyr::select(celltype, label)

combined_df_v11 <- combined_df_v11 %>% dplyr::arrange(is_cytokine)
global_min <- min(c(combined_df_v11$Donor_1, combined_df_v11$Donor_2), na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(c(combined_df_v11$Donor_1, combined_df_v11$Donor_2), na.rm = TRUE)
lim_pad <- (global_max - global_min) * 0.03
axis_lims <- c(global_min - lim_pad, global_max + lim_pad)

E_donor_scatter <- ggplot(combined_df_v11, aes(x = Donor_1, y = Donor_2)) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(combined_df_v11, !is_cytokine), color = "black", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(combined_df_v11, is_cytokine), color = "#CE2029", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = cor_labels, aes(label = label), x = axis_lims[1], y = axis_lims[2],
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 1.7, inherit.aes = FALSE, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype, nrow = 1) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = axis_lims, ylim = axis_lims) +
  labs(x = expression("Donor 1 log"[2]~"(abundance)"), y = expression("Donor 2 log"[2]~"(abundance)")) +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 7),
        legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
cat("  Built: E_donor_scatter (SF1B_G)\n")


# ── V12. Protein abundance rank, cytokines highlighted (SF1B_H right) ────────────────
cat("\n=== V12. Protein abundance rank ===\n")

cells_to_use_v12 <- prot_celltypes %>% dplyr::filter(celltype != "Dendritic cells") %>% dplyr::pull(ID)
mat_sub_v12 <- sc.batch_cor.ab[, cells_to_use_v12, drop = FALSE]
protein_abundance <- data.frame(Gene = rownames(mat_sub_v12),
                                mean_abundance = rowMeans(mat_sub_v12, na.rm = TRUE),
                                n_detected = rowSums(!is.na(mat_sub_v12)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_detected > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number(), is_cytokine = Gene %in% cytokine_genes_v10)
cat(sprintf("  Ranked %d proteins | %d cytokines detected\n",
            nrow(protein_abundance), sum(protein_abundance$is_cytokine)))

cytokine_ranked <- protein_abundance %>% dplyr::filter(is_cytokine) %>% dplyr::arrange(rank)
cytokines_to_label <- c(cytokine_ranked %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 15) %>% dplyr::pull(Gene),
                        cytokine_ranked %>% dplyr::slice_tail(n = 15) %>% dplyr::pull(Gene))
protein_abundance <- protein_abundance %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = ifelse(Gene %in% cytokines_to_label, Gene, "")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(point_type = factor(ifelse(is_cytokine, "Cytokines", "All Proteins"),
                                    levels = c("All Proteins", "Cytokines"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(is_cytokine)

prot_rank_colors <- c("All Proteins" = unname(cytokine_palette["All Proteins"]), "Cytokines" = "#CE2029")

I_prot_rank <- ggplot(protein_abundance, aes(x = rank, y = mean_abundance)) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(protein_abundance, !is_cytokine),
             aes(color = point_type), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(protein_abundance, is_cytokine),
             aes(color = point_type), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(protein_abundance, label != ""),
                           aes(label = label), size = 1.5, color = "black",
                           segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0.1,
                           box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 1, max.overlaps = Inf,
                           force = 4, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = prot_rank_colors, name = NULL,
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
  facet_wrap(~ "Protein") + xlim(0, 4000) +
  labs(x = "Protein Rank", y = expression("Mean log"[2]~"(abundance)")) +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 7),
        legend.position      = c(0.5, 0.97),
        legend.justification = c(0.5, 1),
        legend.direction     = "horizontal",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5), legend.key.size = unit(2, "mm"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
cat("  Built: I_prot_rank (SF1B_H right)\n")


# ── V13. Gene-products per cell — protein-coding reads(inex) vs protein (SF1A_D) ──────
cat("\n=== V13. Gene-products per cell, protein-coding reads intron+exon (SF1A_D) ===\n")

use_log10_v13 <- FALSE   

## --- 0. Ensembl -> biotype map --
ensembl_map_path_v13 <- file.path(metadata_dir, "ensembl_biotype_mapping.rds")
if (exists("mapping_all")) {
  .map_v13 <- mapping_all
  cat("  Using in-session `mapping_all`\n")
} else if (file.exists(ensembl_map_path_v13)) {
  .map_v13 <- readRDS(ensembl_map_path_v13)
  cat(sprintf("  Loaded biotype map: %s (%d rows)\n",
              ensembl_map_path_v13, nrow(.map_v13)))
} else {
  stop(sprintf("[V13] Biotype map not found: %s\n  Run Section 1b of the mRNA ",
               "processing script first (it writes this file).", ensembl_map_path_v13))
}

pc_symbols_v13 <- unique(.map_v13$hgnc_symbol[.map_v13$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
pc_symbols_v13 <- pc_symbols_v13[!is.na(pc_symbols_v13) & pc_symbols_v13 != ""]
id2sym_v13     <- setNames(.map_v13$hgnc_symbol, .map_v13$ensembl_gene_id)
cat(sprintf("  Protein-coding symbols: %d\n", length(pc_symbols_v13)))

## --- 1. mRNA: distinct protein-coding symbols per cell -------------------------------
rc_inex_v13 <- pbmc.rna[["readcount"]][["inex"]][["all"]]

rna_meta_v13 <- rna_celltypes %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% celltype_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = as.character(celltype))

cells_rna_v13 <- base::intersect(rna_meta_v13$cell_id, colnames(rc_inex_v13))
if (length(cells_rna_v13) < nrow(rna_meta_v13))
  cat(sprintf("  NOTE: %d of %d analysis cells absent from readcount/inex (dropped)\n",
              nrow(rna_meta_v13) - length(cells_rna_v13), nrow(rna_meta_v13)))

ids_v13  <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(rc_inex_v13))
syms_v13 <- unname(id2sym_v13[ids_v13])
keep_v13 <- !is.na(syms_v13) & syms_v13 %in% pc_symbols_v13

cat(sprintf("  readcount/inex rows: %d total | %d unmapped | %d protein-coding (%d symbols)\n",
            nrow(rc_inex_v13), sum(is.na(syms_v13)), sum(keep_v13),
            dplyr::n_distinct(syms_v13[keep_v13])))

m_v13   <- rc_inex_v13[keep_v13, cells_rna_v13, drop = FALSE]
s_v13   <- factor(syms_v13[keep_v13])
agg_v13 <- Matrix::fac2sparse(s_v13) %*% (1 * (m_v13 > 0))   # symbols x cells
rna_n_features_v13 <- Matrix::colSums(agg_v13 > 0)

rna_df_v13 <- data.frame(
  n_features = as.numeric(rna_n_features_v13),
  celltype   = rna_meta_v13$celltype[match(colnames(agg_v13), rna_meta_v13$cell_id)],
  modality   = "mRNA", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("  mRNA: %s cells | median protein-coding genes/cell = %s\n",
            format(length(cells_rna_v13), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(median(rna_df_v13$n_features)), big.mark = ",")))

## --- 2. Protein: non-NA gene-products per cell --------------------------------------
prot_meta_v13 <- prot_celltypes %>%
  dplyr::filter(ID %in% colnames(sc.batch_cor), celltype %in% celltype_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = as.character(celltype))

prot_n_features_v13 <- colSums(!is.na(sc.batch_cor[, prot_meta_v13$ID, drop = FALSE]))

prot_df_v13 <- data.frame(
  n_features = as.numeric(prot_n_features_v13),
  celltype   = prot_meta_v13$celltype[match(names(prot_n_features_v13), prot_meta_v13$ID)],
  modality   = "Protein", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("  Protein: %d cells | median gene-products/cell = %d\n",
            nrow(prot_df_v13), round(median(prot_df_v13$n_features))))

## --- 3. Combine + per-cell-type diagnostics -----------------------------------------
geneprod_reads_pc_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(rna_df_v13, prot_df_v13) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_order),
                modality = factor(modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")))

geneprod_reads_pc_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, modality) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(),
                   median  = round(median(n_features)),
                   q25     = round(quantile(n_features, 0.25)),
                   q75     = round(quantile(n_features, 0.75)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names = FALSE)

## --- 4. Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------------
y_hi_v13 <- as.numeric(quantile(geneprod_reads_pc_df$n_features, 0.995))
y_scale_v13 <- if (use_log10_v13) {
  list(scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")),
       coord_cartesian(ylim = c(max(50, min(geneprod_reads_pc_df$n_features)), y_hi_v13)))
} else {
  list(scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ","),
                          expand = expansion(mult = c(0.10, 0.03))),
       coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_hi_v13)))
}

p_geneprod_violin_reads_pc <- ggplot(geneprod_reads_pc_df,
                                     aes(x = celltype, y = n_features, fill = modality)) +
  geom_split_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.75, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(celltype, modality), fill = modality),
               width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
               outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1.0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = modality_colors, name = NULL,
                    labels = c("mRNA" = "mRNA (reads, intron+exon)", "Protein" = "Protein")) +
  ylim(0,6000)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = "# Gene-products / Cell\n(Protein-coding)") +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, angle = 25, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.5, 0.02),
        legend.justification = c(0.5, 0), legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

cat("  Built: p_geneprod_violin_reads_pc (SF1A_D)\n")






# ── SF1A / SF1B assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Assembling SF1A and SF1B ===\n")

SF1_A <- wrap_elements(ICA_Complete_BatchCor)
SF1_B <- wrap_elements(p_cellcount_bar | p_donor_split)
SF1_C <- wrap_elements(D_mrna_pca_donor | D_prot_pca_donor | D_prot_pca_batch)
SF1_D <- wrap_elements(p_geneprod_violin_reads_pc)

# Panel E: mRNA and FACS dotplots side by side on top, protein dotplot beneath.
SF1_E <- wrap_elements(
  (C_rna_dotplot + C_facs_dotplot) / 
  (C_prot_dotplot + plot_spacer()) + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.2))
)

SF1_row1 <- SF1_A + SF1_B + SF1_C + plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 1.8, 2.6))
SF1_row2 <- SF1_D + SF1_E + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))

SF1A <- SF1_row1 / SF1_row2 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"))) &
  figure_theme
save_figure(SF1A, "FigS1", height_mm = 160)


SF1_E <- wrap_elements(H_bulk_ids | H_bulk_ica)
SF1_F <- wrap_elements(splithalf_violin_rel)
SF1_G <- wrap_elements(E_donor_scatter)
SF1_H <- wrap_elements(I_rna_rank | I_prot_rank)
SF1_row3 <- SF1_E + SF1_F + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))

SF1B <- SF1_row3 / SF1_G / SF1_H +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "C", "D"))) &
  figure_theme
save_figure(SF1B, "FigS2", height_mm = 168)


cat("\n=== SF1 section complete (SF1A + SF1B) ===\n")

```

```{r, Script 4}

########################################################################################
## ImmPTR MASTER — SCRIPT 4 / 8 : 
##
## Assembly-only, all eight panel objects are
## produced by upstream spike-in QC/preprocessing scripts and must be in the session.
## Assumes Script 1 (setup) has run (save_figure, figure_theme).
##
## Layout: 2 columns (A left, B right), 4 batch rows each. Height 210 mm.
########################################################################################

# ── Guard: setup + upstream panel objects ────────────────────────────────────────────
local({
  need <- c("save_figure", "figure_theme",
            "SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n2p2", "SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n3p1",
            "SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n6p1", "SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n6p2",
            "RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n2p2", "RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n3p1",
            "RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n6p1", "RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n6p2")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(miss))
    stop(sprintf("[SF2] Missing (run Script 1 setup and upstream spike-in QC scripts first): %s",
                 paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
})

suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })


# ── SF2 assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Assembling SF2 ===\n")

SF2_left_col <- wrap_elements(
  SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n2p2 / SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n3p1 /
    SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n6p1 / SingleCell_Versus_SpikeIn_Abundances_n6p2)

SF2_right_col <- wrap_elements(
  RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n2p2 / RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n3p1 /
    RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n6p1 / RobustRegression_SpikeIns_n6p2)

SF2 <- SF2_left_col + SF2_right_col +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B"))) &
  figure_theme

save_figure(SF2, "FigS3", height_mm = 210)
cat("\n=== SF2 section complete ===\n")
```

```{r, Script 5}
########################################################################################
## SCRIPT 5 / 8 :
##
## Assumes Script 1 has run (setup):
## sc.batch_cor.pep(.ab), pep_prot_map_integrated, pbmc.prot, cell_types_df,
## celltype_order/_colors, split_half_reliability(), save_figure, figure_theme.
##
##
## Helpers from prep scripts: CytokineSpikeIns, CytokineSpikeInsFull
########################################################################################

# ── Guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local({
  need <- c("sc.batch_cor.pep", "sc.batch_cor.pep.ab", "pep_prot_map_integrated",
            "pbmc.prot", "cell_types_df", "celltype_order", "celltype_colors",
            "split_half_reliability", "save_figure", "figure_theme", "results_dir",
            "CytokineSpikeIns", "CytokineSpikeInsFull")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(miss))
    stop(sprintf("[SF3] Missing (run Script 1 setup and prep scripts first): %s",
                 paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
})

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(patchwork); library(ggplotify); library(grid); library(ggrepel)
})


# ── V13.0. SF3-specific configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
min_cells_per_celltype_v13 <- 10
n_iterations_v13           <- 100
n_null_iterations_v13      <- 100

cytokine_color_v13 <- "#CE2029"; gdf6_color <- cytokine_color_v13; gdf6_border <- "black"; gdf6_size <- 2.5
rpl8_color <- "black"; rpl8_border <- "black"; rpl8_size <- 2.5
proteome_color <- "grey70"; null_color <- "grey70"; regression_color <- "black"; zero_line <- "grey70"

theme_reliability <- function() {
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, plot.title = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
}


# ── V13.1. Peptide-level inputs (matrices/map from setup; cell->batch local) ─────────
cat("\n=== V13. SF3 reliability pipeline ===\n")

pep_prot_map <- pep_prot_map_integrated   # alias for local readability

# cell_types_df (setup) is already DC-excluded and in (Cell, CellType, batch) schema.
ct_all <- data.frame(Cell = cell_types_df$Cell, CellType = cell_types_df$CellType,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Cell -> dataset_batch lookup from per-batch identification tables.
build_id_df <- function(batch) {
  df <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, paste0("IdentificationsList_", batch, ".csv")))
  df$File.Name     <- paste0(df$File.Name, "_", batch)
  df$dataset_batch <- batch
  df %>% dplyr::select(File.Name, dataset_batch)
}
pep_df_dataset_labels <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  c("n2p1", "n2p2", "n3p1", "n6p1", "n6p2"), build_id_df)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ID = File.Name) %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("  Peptide matrices: %d peptides x %d cells\n",
            nrow(sc.batch_cor.pep), ncol(sc.batch_cor.pep)))


# ── V13.2. Eligibility funnel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
proteotypic_peptides_strict <- pep_prot_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_proteotypic_strict, genes_consistent) %>% pull(Stripped.Sequence)

pep_for_rel <- sc.batch_cor.pep[
  rownames(sc.batch_cor.pep) %in% proteotypic_peptides_strict,
  colnames(sc.batch_cor.pep) %in% ct_all$Cell]

ct_lookup     <- setNames(ct_all$CellType, ct_all$Cell)
cell_celltype <- ct_lookup[colnames(pep_for_rel)]

pep_ct_det <- sapply(unique(cell_celltype), function(ct) {
  rowSums(!is.na(pep_for_rel[, which(cell_celltype == ct), drop = FALSE]))
})
colnames(pep_ct_det) <- unique(cell_celltype)
peptides_pass_detection <- rownames(pep_ct_det)[
  apply(pep_ct_det, 1, function(x) all(x >= min_cells_per_celltype_v13))]

pep_to_gene <- pep_prot_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(Stripped.Sequence %in% rownames(pep_for_rel)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Stripped.Sequence, Genes) %>% distinct()

protein_peptide_counts <- pep_to_gene %>%
  dplyr::filter(Stripped.Sequence %in% peptides_pass_detection) %>%
  group_by(Genes) %>% summarise(n_peptides = n_distinct(Stripped.Sequence), .groups = "drop")
proteins_for_reliability <- protein_peptide_counts %>% dplyr::filter(n_peptides >= 2) %>% pull(Genes)

cat(sprintf("  Funnel: strict proteotypic %d | pass detection floor %d | eligible proteins (>=2 pep) %d\n",
            length(proteotypic_peptides_strict), length(peptides_pass_detection),
            length(proteins_for_reliability)))


# ── V13.4. Primary reliability (full proteome) — uses setup split_half_reliability ───
set.seed(42)   # LOCAL
reliability_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(proteins_for_reliability, function(g)
  split_half_reliability(gene = g, pep_to_gene = pep_to_gene, pep_mat = pep_for_rel,
                         cell_celltype = cell_celltype, cell_type_order = celltype_order,
                         peptides_pass_filter = peptides_pass_detection,
                         n_iter = n_iterations_v13, method = "pearson")))

reliability_summary <- reliability_full %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, n_peptides) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_cor = median(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean_cor = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_cor = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("  Full-proteome reliability: %d proteins; median r = %.3f\n",
            nrow(reliability_summary), median(reliability_summary$median_cor, na.rm = TRUE)))


# ── V13.5. Cytokine subset ──────────────
cytokine_genes_in_set <- base::intersect(CytokineSpikeIns$Genes, proteins_for_reliability)
reliability_cytokines <- reliability_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% cytokine_genes_in_set) %>% arrange(desc(median_cor))

cytokine_vs_proteome_test <- wilcox.test(reliability_cytokines$median_cor,
                                         reliability_summary$median_cor)
cat(sprintf("  Cytokine reliability: %d cytokines; median r = %.3f (Wilcoxon vs full proteome p = %.2e)\n",
            nrow(reliability_cytokines), median(reliability_cytokines$median_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
            cytokine_vs_proteome_test$p.value))


# ── V13.6. Panel-membership control — per-gene PAIRED test ───────────────────
panel_peptide_sequences_all <- CytokineSpikeInsFull %>%
  dplyr::select(Sequence..origin.) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(Sequence..origin., sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(Sequence..origin. = trimws(Sequence..origin.)) %>%
  distinct() %>% dplyr::filter(Sequence..origin. != "") %>% pull(Sequence..origin.)
panel_peptide_sequences <- panel_peptide_sequences_all[!grepl("C", panel_peptide_sequences_all)]

peptide_loo_reliability <- function(gene, pep_to_gene, pep_mat, cell_celltype,
                                    cell_type_order, peptides_pass_filter = NULL, method = "pearson") {
  peptides <- pep_to_gene$Stripped.Sequence[pep_to_gene$Genes == gene]
  peptides <- intersect(peptides, rownames(pep_mat))
  if (!is.null(peptides_pass_filter)) peptides <- intersect(peptides, peptides_pass_filter)
  n_pep <- length(peptides); if (n_pep < 2) return(NULL)
  pep_sub <- pep_mat[peptides, , drop = FALSE]
  ct_means <- sapply(cell_type_order, function(ct)
    rowMeans(pep_sub[, which(cell_celltype == ct), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
  loo_cors <- sapply(seq_len(n_pep), function(i) {
    target <- ct_means[i, ]; others <- colMeans(ct_means[-i, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(cor(target, others, method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  })
  data.frame(gene = gene, peptide = peptides, loo_correlation = loo_cors)
}

cytokine_peptide_reliability <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cytokine_genes_in_set, function(g)
  peptide_loo_reliability(gene = g, pep_to_gene = pep_to_gene, pep_mat = pep_for_rel,
                          cell_celltype = cell_celltype, cell_type_order = celltype_order,
                          peptides_pass_filter = peptides_pass_detection, method = "pearson"))) %>%
  mutate(in_panel = peptide %in% panel_peptide_sequences)

cytokine_pep_breakdown <- cytokine_peptide_reliability %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(n_in_panel = sum(in_panel), n_not_in_panel = sum(!in_panel), .groups = "drop")
matched_genes <- cytokine_pep_breakdown %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_in_panel > 0 & n_not_in_panel > 0) %>% pull(gene)
cytokine_peptide_reliability_matched <- cytokine_peptide_reliability %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% matched_genes)

panel_matched_bygene <- cytokine_peptide_reliability_matched %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(in_med  = median(loo_correlation[in_panel],  na.rm = TRUE),
            out_med = median(loo_correlation[!in_panel], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(in_med), is.finite(out_med))
panel_test <- if (nrow(panel_matched_bygene) >= 2) {
  wilcox.test(panel_matched_bygene$in_med, panel_matched_bygene$out_med, paired = TRUE)
} else {
  list(p.value = NA_real_)
}
cat(sprintf("  Panel control (per-gene PAIRED): %d genes paired; Wilcoxon p = %.2e\n",
            nrow(panel_matched_bygene), panel_test$p.value))


# ── V13.7. Proteome-wide peptide LOO ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
proteome_peptide_reliability <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(proteins_for_reliability, function(g)
  peptide_loo_reliability(gene = g, pep_to_gene = pep_to_gene, pep_mat = pep_for_rel,
                          cell_celltype = cell_celltype, cell_type_order = celltype_order,
                          peptides_pass_filter = peptides_pass_detection, method = "pearson"))) %>%
  mutate(in_panel = peptide %in% panel_peptide_sequences,
         is_cytokine = gene %in% cytokine_genes_in_set)
cat(sprintf("  Proteome-wide LOO: %d peptides across %d proteins; median r = %.3f\n",
            nrow(proteome_peptide_reliability), length(unique(proteome_peptide_reliability$gene)),
            median(proteome_peptide_reliability$loo_correlation, na.rm = TRUE)))


# ── V13.8. Reliability vs peptide count + vs abundance ───────────────────────────────
reliability_summary <- reliability_summary %>%
  mutate(peptide_bin = case_when(
    n_peptides == 2 ~ "2", n_peptides == 3 ~ "3", n_peptides == 4 ~ "4",
    n_peptides %in% 5:6 ~ "5-6", n_peptides %in% 7:10 ~ "7-10", n_peptides > 10 ~ ">10")) %>%
  mutate(peptide_bin = factor(peptide_bin, levels = c("2", "3", "4", "5-6", "7-10", ">10")))

abs_peptide_mean <- rowMeans(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab[
  rownames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% peptides_pass_detection,
  colnames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% ct_all$Cell], na.rm = TRUE)

protein_abundance_v13 <- pep_to_gene %>%
  dplyr::filter(Stripped.Sequence %in% names(abs_peptide_mean), Genes %in% proteins_for_reliability) %>%
  mutate(peptide_abundance = abs_peptide_mean[Stripped.Sequence]) %>%
  group_by(Genes) %>% summarise(mean_log2_abundance = mean(peptide_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(gene = Genes)

reliability_summary <- reliability_summary %>%
  left_join(protein_abundance_v13, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(is_cytokine = gene %in% cytokine_genes_in_set)


# ── V13.9. Strict null (Panel B) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
per_gene_ct_means <- lapply(proteins_for_reliability, function(g) {
  peps <- intersect(intersect(pep_to_gene$Stripped.Sequence[pep_to_gene$Genes == g],
                              rownames(pep_for_rel)), peptides_pass_detection)
  if (length(peps) < 2) return(NULL)
  pep_sub <- pep_for_rel[peps, , drop = FALSE]
  ct_means <- sapply(celltype_order, function(ct)
    rowMeans(pep_sub[, which(cell_celltype == ct), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
  list(peptides = peps, ct_means = ct_means, n_pep = length(peps))
})
names(per_gene_ct_means) <- proteins_for_reliability
per_gene_ct_means <- per_gene_ct_means[!sapply(per_gene_ct_means, is.null)]
gene_pool <- names(per_gene_ct_means)

set.seed(42)   # LOCAL
null_strict_iterations <- vector("list", n_null_iterations_v13)
for (iter in seq_len(n_null_iterations_v13)) {
  null_cors <- numeric(length(gene_pool))
  for (i in seq_along(gene_pool)) {
    g_data <- per_gene_ct_means[[gene_pool[i]]]; n_pep <- g_data$n_pep
    shuffled_ct_means <- t(apply(g_data$ct_means, 1, sample))   # within-peptide label permutation
    if (n_pep == 2) {
      null_cors[i] <- suppressWarnings(cor(shuffled_ct_means[1, ], shuffled_ct_means[2, ],
                                           method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    } else {
      half_size <- floor(n_pep / 2)
      idx_h1 <- sample(seq_len(n_pep), half_size); idx_h2 <- setdiff(seq_len(n_pep), idx_h1)
      h1_means <- colMeans(shuffled_ct_means[idx_h1, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      h2_means <- colMeans(shuffled_ct_means[idx_h2, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      null_cors[i] <- suppressWarnings(cor(h1_means, h2_means, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    }
  }
  null_strict_iterations[[iter]] <- data.frame(gene = gene_pool, iteration = iter, correlation = null_cors)
  if (iter %% 20 == 0) cat(sprintf("    Null iter %d / %d\n", iter, n_null_iterations_v13))
}
null_strict_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(null_strict_iterations)
null_strict_summary <- null_strict_full %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>% dplyr::summarise(median_cor = median(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("  Strict null: median r = %.3f\n", median(null_strict_summary$median_cor, na.rm = TRUE)))


# ── V13.10. Biological variability (SD across cells) ───────────────
proteome_pep_mat <- sc.batch_cor.pep.ab[
  rownames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% peptides_pass_detection,
  colnames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% ct_all$Cell]
proteome_pep_mat <- proteome_pep_mat[, names(cell_celltype)]

gene_to_peps <- pep_to_gene %>%
  dplyr::filter(Stripped.Sequence %in% rownames(proteome_pep_mat), Genes %in% proteins_for_reliability) %>%
  group_by(Genes) %>% summarise(peptides = list(Stripped.Sequence), .groups = "drop")
protein_cell_mat <- t(sapply(gene_to_peps$Genes, function(g)
  colMeans(proteome_pep_mat[gene_to_peps$peptides[gene_to_peps$Genes == g][[1]], , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)))
rownames(protein_cell_mat) <- gene_to_peps$Genes

cv_df <- data.frame(gene = rownames(protein_cell_mat),
                    sd_mixed = apply(protein_cell_mat, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)),  # RENAMED: SD, not CV
                    is_cytokine = rownames(protein_cell_mat) %in% cytokine_genes_in_set)
abundance_vs_cv <- reliability_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, mean_log2_abundance, is_cytokine) %>%
  left_join(cv_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, sd_mixed), by = "gene")


# ── V13.11. Panel B — reliability distributions (null | proteome | cytokines) ────────
reliability_for_violin <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  null_strict_summary %>% dplyr::select(gene, median_cor) %>% mutate(category = "Null"),
  reliability_summary %>% mutate(category = "Proteome") %>% dplyr::select(gene, median_cor, category),
  reliability_summary %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% cytokine_genes_in_set) %>%
    mutate(category = "Cytokines") %>% dplyr::select(gene, median_cor, category)) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c("Null", "Proteome", "Cytokines")))
n_null <- sum(reliability_for_violin$category == "Null")
n_proteome <- sum(reliability_for_violin$category == "Proteome")
n_cytokines <- sum(reliability_for_violin$category == "Cytokines")

p_reliability_dist <- ggplot(reliability_for_violin, aes(x = category, y = median_cor, fill = category)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = zero_line, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = category), width = 0.06, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", alpha = 0.95, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Null" = null_color, "Proteome" = proteome_color, "Cytokines" = cytokine_color_v13), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(sprintf("Null\n(n = %d)", n_null), sprintf("Proteome\n(n = %d)", n_proteome),
                              sprintf("Cytokines\n(n = %d)", n_cytokines))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Split-half correlation (median)") + theme_reliability()


# ── V13.12. Panel C — reliability vs abundance ───────────────────────────────────────
genes_to_annotate <- c("GDF6", "RPL8")
annotation_df_v13 <- reliability_summary %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes_to_annotate)
p_reliability_vs_abund <- ggplot(reliability_summary, aes(x = mean_log2_abundance, y = median_cor)) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% dplyr::filter(!is_cytokine), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.35, size = 1.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = regression_color, fill = regression_color, alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.5, se = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% dplyr::filter(is_cytokine, !gene %in% genes_to_annotate), color = cytokine_color_v13, alpha = 0.8, size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = annotation_df_v13 %>% dplyr::filter(gene == "GDF6"), fill = gdf6_color, color = gdf6_border, shape = 21, size = gdf6_size, stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = annotation_df_v13 %>% dplyr::filter(gene == "RPL8"), fill = rpl8_color, color = rpl8_border, shape = 21, size = rpl8_size, stroke = 0.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = annotation_df_v13, aes(label = gene), size = 2.5, fontface = "bold",
                           box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3, segment.color = "black", segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = expression("Mean peptide abundance per protein, log"[2]), y = "Split-half correlation (median)") +
  theme_reliability()


# ── V13.13. Panel D — reliability vs peptide count ───────────────────────────────────
p_reliability_vs_npep <- ggplot(reliability_summary, aes(x = peptide_bin, y = median_cor)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = zero_line, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = proteome_color, alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "# Proteotypic peptides per protein", y = "Split-half correlation (median)") +

# ── V13.14b. Panel E  ───────────────────────────────
cytokine_peptide_reliability_matched <- cytokine_peptide_reliability_matched %>%

  ) +

# ── V13.15. Panel F — peptide-level LOO vs peptide abundance ─────────────────────────
proteome_peptide_reliability <- proteome_peptide_reliability %>%

gdf6_peptides_df <- proteome_peptide_reliability %>% dplyr::filter(gene == "GDF6")

  geom_point(data = gdf6_peptides_df, fill = gdf6_color, color = gdf6_border, shape = 21, size = gdf6_size, stroke = 0.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = gdf6_peptides_df %>% slice(1), aes(label = "GDF6"), size = 2.5, fontface = "bold",

           color = "black", size = 2.2, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.8) +

# ── V13.16. Panel G — abundance vs biological SD ─────────────────────────────────────
p_abund_vs_cv <- ggplot(abundance_vs_cv, aes(x = mean_log2_abundance, y = sd_mixed)) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% dplyr::filter(!is_cytokine), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.35, size = 1.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = regression_color, fill = regression_color, alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.5, se = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% dplyr::filter(is_cytokine), color = cytokine_color_v13, alpha = 0.85, size = 1.3) +

  labs(x = expression("Mean peptide abundance per protein, log"[2]), y = expression("SD across cells (log"[2]~"abundance)")) +

# ── V13.17. Panel A — cytokine completeness heatmap ──────────────────────────────────
cytokine_panel_peptides <- pep_prot_map %>%
  filter(is_proteotypic_strict, genes_consistent,
         Stripped.Sequence %in% panel_peptide_sequences, Genes %in% CytokineSpikeIns$Genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(Stripped.Sequence, Genes)

cyto_pep_mat <- sc.batch_cor.pep.ab[
  rownames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% cytokine_panel_peptides$Stripped.Sequence,
  colnames(sc.batch_cor.pep.ab) %in% ct_all$Cell]
detection_mat <- as.matrix(!is.na(cyto_pep_mat)) * 1L

batch_order <- c("n2p2", "n3p1", "n6p1", "n6p2", "n2p1")
panel_added_batches <- c("n6p1", "n6p2", "n2p1")

SF3_A <- as.ggplot(grid.grabExpr(draw(cytokine_completeness_hm,
```

```{r, Script 6}
local({

set.seed(42)   


# ── M0.6  MF2 master parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mf2_params <- list(
  min_datapoints_default     = 100,
```
