# ── Lookups: ───────────────────────
prot_celltypes_full <- prot_celltypes                       
rna_celltypes_full  <- rna_celltypes                        
cat("  Protein cells per cell type:\n"); print(table(prot_celltypes_full$celltype))
cat("  mRNA cells per cell type:\n");    print(table(rna_celltypes_full$celltype))


# ── P2  Mathieson 2018 half-life loader ─────────────────────
cat("\n[P2] Loading Mathieson 2018 half-life table ...\n")
df.deg.rates.full <- read.csv(mathieson_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                              na.strings = c("", "NA", "#N/A", "Inf", "-Inf"))
clean_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

process_degradation_rates <- function(df, celltype_pattern, celltype_name) {
  ct_cols <- grep(paste0("^", celltype_pattern, "\\."), colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(ct_cols) == 0) stop(sprintf("[P2] No columns match '%s'", celltype_pattern))
  sub <- df %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of("Gene_name"), dplyr::all_of(ct_cols))
  num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sub), "Gene_name"); sub[num_cols] <- lapply(sub[num_cols], clean_numeric)
  hl_cols <- grep("half_life", ct_cols, value = TRUE); rsq_cols <- grep("R_sq", ct_cols, value = TRUE)
  qual_cols <- grep("dataQual", ct_cols, value = TRUE)
  if (length(hl_cols) < 2 || length(rsq_cols) < 2)
    stop(sprintf("[P2] Expected >=2 half_life & R_sq cols for '%s'", celltype_pattern))
  dq <- df[, qual_cols, drop = FALSE]; keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(sub))
  for (rc in rsq_cols)  keep <- keep & !is.na(sub[[rc]]) & sub[[rc]] >= 0.80
  for (qc in qual_cols) keep <- keep & !is.na(dq[[qc]]) & dq[[qc]] == "good"
  sub <- sub[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  sub$half_life <- rowMeans(sub[, hl_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  sub <- sub %>% dplyr::mutate(kdeg = 0.693 / half_life, log_kdeg = log(kdeg),
                               log_half_life = log(half_life), celltype = celltype_name) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(half_life), is.finite(log_half_life), is.finite(log_kdeg))
  if ("Gene_name" %in% colnames(sub)) sub <- sub %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Gene_name)
  else { gn_col <- grep("[Gg]ene.*[Nn]ame|^Gene$", colnames(df), value = TRUE)[1]; sub$gene <- df[[gn_col]][keep] }
  sub %>% dplyr::select(gene, half_life, kdeg, log_half_life, log_kdeg, celltype)
}
df.deg.rates.NK   <- process_degradation_rates(df.deg.rates.full, "NK.cells",  "NK cells")
df.deg.rates.B    <- process_degradation_rates(df.deg.rates.full, "Bcells",    "B cells")
df.deg.rates.Mono <- process_degradation_rates(df.deg.rates.full, "Monocytes", "Monocytes")
df.deg.rates.combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(df.deg.rates.NK, df.deg.rates.B, df.deg.rates.Mono)
halflife_tables <- list("NK cells" = df.deg.rates.NK, "B cells" = df.deg.rates.B, "Monocytes" = df.deg.rates.Mono)
cat(sprintf("  NK %d | B %d | Mono %d genes with reliable half-life\n",
            nrow(df.deg.rates.NK), nrow(df.deg.rates.B), nrow(df.deg.rates.Mono)))


# ── P3  CORUM parse ───────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[P3] Parsing CORUM (raw from setup) ...\n")
subunit_col <- grep("subunit.*[Gg]ene.*name", colnames(corum_raw), value = TRUE)[1]
if (is.na(subunit_col)) stop("[P3] CORUM subunit gene-name column not found.")

parse_subunit_string <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || s == "") return(character(0))
  parts <- strsplit(gsub("\\([^()]*\\)", "", s), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  parts <- trimws(parts); parts[parts != ""]
}
corum_human <- corum_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subunit_genes = lapply(.data[[subunit_col]], parse_subunit_string),
                n_subunits_annotated = vapply(subunit_genes, length, integer(1)))
cat(sprintf("  CORUM complexes: %d\n", nrow(corum_human)))

# P3b ribosomal set
ribo_name_col <- if ("ComplexName" %in% colnames(corum_human)) "ComplexName" else {
  cand <- grep("[Cc]omplex.*[Nn]ame|^name$", colnames(corum_human), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(cand)) stop("[P3b] CORUM complex-name column not found.") else cand
}
ribo_complex_mask <- grepl("cytoplasmic.*ribosome|ribosome.*cytoplasmic|\\b40S\\b|\\b60S\\b",
                           corum_human[[ribo_name_col]], ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
ribosome_complexes <- corum_human[ribo_complex_mask, , drop = FALSE]
ribosome_genes <- unique(unlist(ribosome_complexes$subunit_genes))
ribosome_genes <- ribosome_genes[!is.na(ribosome_genes) & ribosome_genes != ""]
cat(sprintf("  Ribosome complexes: %d | subunit genes: %d\n",
            nrow(ribosome_complexes), length(ribosome_genes)))


# ── P4  Cell-type (shared genes) ──────────────────────────────
mf2_shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(sc.batch_cor),
                              rownames(GetAssayData(pbmc.so, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")))
get_celltype_cells <- function(celltype) {
  list(prot_ids     = prot_celltypes_full %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == !!celltype) %>% dplyr::pull(ID),
       rna_ids      = rna_celltypes_full  %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == !!celltype) %>% dplyr::pull(cell_id),
       shared_genes = mf2_shared_genes)
}


# ── P5  Concordance ─────
min_datapoints_default <- mf2_params$min_datapoints_default
rna_norm <- GetAssayData(pbmc.so, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")[, rna_celltypes_full$cell_id]
rna_mat_log2 <- as.matrix(rna_norm / log(2))
rna_mat_log2_centered <- sweep(rna_mat_log2, 1, rowMeans(rna_mat_log2, na.rm = TRUE), "-")

get_pairwise_n <- function(mat) { is_obs <- !is.na(mat); storage.mode(is_obs) <- "integer"; tcrossprod(is_obs) }
extract_upper_triangle <- function(cor_mat, n_mat, gene_names) {
  ut <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(gene1 = gene_names[ut[, 1]], gene2 = gene_names[ut[, 2]],
             correlation = cor_mat[ut], n = n_mat[ut], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
compute_concordance <- function(celltype, gene_subset = NULL,
                                min_datapoints = min_datapoints_default, verbose = TRUE) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(celltype)
  prot_mat_ct <- sc.batch_cor[, ids$prot_ids, drop = FALSE]
  rna_mat_ct  <- rna_mat_log2_centered[, ids$rna_ids, drop = FALSE]
  shared_genes_ct <- intersect(rownames(prot_mat_ct), rownames(rna_mat_ct))
  if (!is.null(gene_subset)) shared_genes_ct <- intersect(shared_genes_ct, gene_subset)
  prot_mat_ct <- prot_mat_ct[shared_genes_ct, , drop = FALSE]
  rna_mat_ct  <- rna_mat_ct[shared_genes_ct, , drop = FALSE]
  prot_sd <- apply(prot_mat_ct, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE); rna_sd <- apply(rna_mat_ct, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ok <- !is.na(prot_sd) & !is.na(rna_sd) & prot_sd > 0 & rna_sd > 0
  genes_with_variance <- shared_genes_ct[ok]
  if (verbose) cat(sprintf("  [%s] shared %d | with variance %d | prot cells %d | mRNA cells %d\n",
                           celltype, length(shared_genes_ct), length(genes_with_variance),
                           ncol(prot_mat_ct), ncol(rna_mat_ct)))
  prot_mat_ct <- prot_mat_ct[genes_with_variance, , drop = FALSE]
  rna_mat_ct  <- rna_mat_ct[genes_with_variance, , drop = FALSE]
  prot_cor_mat <- cor(t(prot_mat_ct), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  prot_n_mat   <- get_pairwise_n(prot_mat_ct)
  rna_cor_mat  <- cor(t(rna_mat_ct),  method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  rna_n_mat    <- get_pairwise_n(rna_mat_ct)
  prot_pairs <- extract_upper_triangle(prot_cor_mat, prot_n_mat, genes_with_variance)
  colnames(prot_pairs) <- c("gene1", "gene2", "prot_cor", "prot_n")
  rna_pairs  <- extract_upper_triangle(rna_cor_mat, rna_n_mat, genes_with_variance)
  colnames(rna_pairs) <- c("gene1", "gene2", "rna_cor", "rna_n")
  prot_pairs_filt <- prot_pairs %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(prot_cor), prot_n >= min_datapoints) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste(gene1, gene2, sep = "_"))
  rna_pairs_filt <- rna_pairs %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(rna_cor)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste(gene1, gene2, sep = "_"))
  common_pairs <- intersect(prot_pairs_filt$pair_id, rna_pairs_filt$pair_id)
  merged_data <- prot_pairs_filt %>% dplyr::filter(pair_id %in% common_pairs) %>%
    dplyr::select(pair_id, gene1, gene2, prot_cor, prot_n) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(rna_pairs_filt %>% dplyr::filter(pair_id %in% common_pairs) %>%
                        dplyr::select(pair_id, rna_cor, rna_n), by = "pair_id")
  concordance_r <- if (nrow(merged_data) >= 3)
    cor(merged_data$prot_cor, merged_data$rna_cor, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs") else NA_real_
  list(celltype = celltype, n_pairs = nrow(merged_data), concordance_r = concordance_r,
       data = merged_data, genes_used = genes_with_variance)
}


# ── M1  B-cell concordance scatter [MF2 A] ───────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nM1 — B-cell concordance scatter [MF2 A]\n")
m1_bcell <- compute_concordance("B cells", NULL, mf2_params$m1_min_datapoints, TRUE)
cat(sprintf("  B-cell concordance r = %.3f (n = %s pairs)\n",
            m1_bcell$concordance_r, format(m1_bcell$n_pairs, big.mark = ",")))
p_m1_bcell_concordance <- ggplot(m1_bcell$data, aes(x = prot_cor, y = rna_cor)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 100) + scale_fill_viridis(option = "viridis", guide = "none") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("r = %.3f\nn = %s", m1_bcell$concordance_r,
                                                      format(m1_bcell$n_pairs, big.mark = ",")),
           hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.2, fontface = "bold") +
  xlim(-1, 1) + ylim(-1, 1) + coord_fixed() + facet_wrap(~ "B cells") +
  labs(x = "Protein-protein correlation", y = "mRNA-mRNA correlation") +
  theme_light(base_size = 6.5) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7), axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 7), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


# ── R1  Split-half reliability summary (feeds M3) ────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nR1 — peptide split-half reliability\n")
m2_reliability_metric <- mf2_params$m2_reliability_metric
m2_reliability_cutoff <- mf2_params$m2_reliability_cutoff
m2_splithalf_n_iter   <- mf2_params$splithalf_n_iter
m2_splithalf_method   <- mf2_params$splithalf_method
m2_splithalf_seed     <- mf2_params$splithalf_seed
m2_min_cells_detection_per_ct <- mf2_params$min_cells_detection_per_ct

# split_half_reliability() is defined once in setup.
proteotypic_peptides_strict <- pep_prot_map_integrated %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_proteotypic_strict, genes_consistent) %>% dplyr::pull(Stripped.Sequence) %>% unique()
pep_mat_v13 <- sc.batch_cor.pep[intersect(rownames(sc.batch_cor.pep), proteotypic_peptides_strict), , drop = FALSE]
cell_celltype_prot <- setNames(as.character(pbmc.prot@active.ident), colnames(pbmc.prot))[colnames(pep_mat_v13)]
cell_type_order_v13 <- celltype_order
stopifnot(all(cell_type_order_v13 %in% unique(cell_celltype_prot)))

pep_ct_detect_counts <- vapply(cell_type_order_v13, function(ct) {
  cells_in_ct <- intersect(names(cell_celltype_prot)[cell_celltype_prot == ct], colnames(pep_mat_v13))
  rowSums(!is.na(pep_mat_v13[, cells_in_ct, drop = FALSE]))
}, numeric(nrow(pep_mat_v13)))
peptides_pass_filter <- rownames(pep_mat_v13)[
  rowSums(pep_ct_detect_counts >= m2_min_cells_detection_per_ct) == length(cell_type_order_v13)]

pep_to_gene_v13 <- pep_prot_map_integrated %>% dplyr::select(Stripped.Sequence, Genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "")
genes_eligible <- pep_to_gene_v13 %>% dplyr::filter(Stripped.Sequence %in% peptides_pass_filter) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>% dplyr::summarise(n_pep = dplyr::n_distinct(Stripped.Sequence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_pep >= 2) %>% dplyr::pull(Genes)
cat(sprintf("  Eligible genes (>=2 filter-passing peptides): %d\n", length(genes_eligible)))

set.seed(m2_splithalf_seed)   # LOCAL
reliability_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(genes_eligible, function(g)
  split_half_reliability(gene = g, pep_to_gene = pep_to_gene_v13, pep_mat = pep_mat_v13,
                         cell_celltype = cell_celltype_prot, cell_type_order = cell_type_order_v13,
                         peptides_pass_filter = peptides_pass_filter,
                         n_iter = m2_splithalf_n_iter, method = m2_splithalf_method, seed = NULL)))
reliability_summary <- reliability_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, n_peptides) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_cor = median(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean_cor = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), sd_cor = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
                   cor_q025 = quantile(correlation, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
                   cor_q975 = quantile(correlation, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
                   n_iter_used = sum(!is.na(correlation)), .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("  Reliability genes: %d | passing > %.2f: %d\n", nrow(reliability_summary),
            m2_reliability_cutoff, sum(reliability_summary[[m2_reliability_metric]] > m2_reliability_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)))


# ── M3  Reliability sweep [SF4A A] ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nM3 — reliability sweep [SF4A A]\n")
m3_reliability_cutoffs <- c(NA, 0, seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1))
m3_min_datapoints <- mf2_params$m3_min_datapoints
m3_left_color <- "#000000"; m3_right_color <- "#AD03DE"

m3_sweep_rows <- list()
for (cutoff in m3_reliability_cutoffs) {
  if (is.na(cutoff)) { bin_label <- "All proteins"; gene_subset <- NULL }
  else { bin_label <- if (cutoff == 0) "> 0" else sprintf("> %.1f", cutoff)
  gene_subset <- reliability_summary %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[m2_reliability_metric]] > cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique() }
  for (ct in celltype_order) {
    res <- compute_concordance(ct, gene_subset = gene_subset, min_datapoints = m3_min_datapoints, verbose = FALSE)
    m3_sweep_rows[[length(m3_sweep_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      bin = bin_label, cutoff_numeric = ifelse(is.na(cutoff), -Inf, cutoff),
      celltype = ct, concordance_r = res$concordance_r, n_pairs = res$n_pairs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}
m3_sweep_per_ct <- dplyr::bind_rows(m3_sweep_rows) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = factor(bin, levels = c("All proteins",
                                             sapply(m3_reliability_cutoffs[!is.na(m3_reliability_cutoffs)], function(x) if (x == 0) "> 0" else sprintf("> %.1f", x)))))
m3_sweep_results <- m3_sweep_per_ct %>% dplyr::group_by(bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_concordance_r = mean(concordance_r, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_concordance_r = sd(concordance_r, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean_n_pairs = mean(n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), sd_n_pairs = sd(n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_celltypes_used = sum(is.finite(concordance_r)), .groups = "drop") %>% dplyr::arrange(bin)

m3_y_left_min <- 0; m3_y_left_max <- 0.3
m3_y_right_min <- min(m3_sweep_results$mean_n_pairs - m3_sweep_results$sd_n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE)
m3_y_right_max <- max(m3_sweep_results$mean_n_pairs + m3_sweep_results$sd_n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE)
m3_pad_right <- 0.04 * (m3_y_right_max - m3_y_right_min)
m3_y_right_min <- m3_y_right_min - m3_pad_right; m3_y_right_max <- m3_y_right_max + m3_pad_right
m3_right_to_left <- function(y) (y - m3_y_right_min) / (m3_y_right_max - m3_y_right_min) * (m3_y_left_max - m3_y_left_min) + m3_y_left_min
m3_left_to_right <- function(y) (y - m3_y_left_min) / (m3_y_left_max - m3_y_left_min) * (m3_y_right_max - m3_y_right_min) + m3_y_right_min

m3_plot_df <- m3_sweep_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_n_pairs_scaled = m3_right_to_left(mean_n_pairs),
                sd_n_pairs_scaled_lo = m3_right_to_left(mean_n_pairs - sd_n_pairs),
                sd_n_pairs_scaled_hi = m3_right_to_left(mean_n_pairs + sd_n_pairs),
                is_all_proteins = bin == "All proteins", bin_x = as.integer(bin))
m3_plot_df_filt <- m3_plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is_all_proteins)
p_m3_reliability_sweep <- ggplot(m3_plot_df, aes(x = bin_x)) +
  geom_line(data = m3_plot_df_filt, aes(y = mean_concordance_r), color = m3_left_color, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_concordance_r - sd_concordance_r, ymax = mean_concordance_r + sd_concordance_r),
                color = m3_left_color, width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_concordance_r), color = m3_left_color, size = 1.6) +
  geom_line(data = m3_plot_df_filt, aes(y = mean_n_pairs_scaled), color = m3_right_color, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = sd_n_pairs_scaled_lo, ymax = sd_n_pairs_scaled_hi), color = m3_right_color, width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_n_pairs_scaled), color = m3_right_color, size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = m3_plot_df$bin_x, labels = as.character(m3_plot_df$bin), expand = expansion(add = 0.35)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Mean concordance\nacross cell types", limits = c(m3_y_left_min, m3_y_left_max),
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(transform = ~ m3_left_to_right(.), name = "Mean # correlation pairs",
                                         labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()))) +
  labs(x = "Protein reliability (median split-half r)") +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = m3_left_color, size = 7.5),
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = m3_right_color, size = 7.5),
        axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = m3_left_color, size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = m3_right_color, size = 6.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5.5, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


# ── M4  Half-life vs mean abundance [SF4A B] ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nM4 — half-life vs mean abundance [SF4A B]\n")
m4_log_base <- mf2_params$m4_log_base; m4_celltypes <- names(halflife_tables)
rna_abund_log2 <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(pbmc.so, layer = "data", assay = "RNA") / log(2))

build_m4_data_one_ct <- function(ct) {
  hl <- halflife_tables[[ct]] %>% dplyr::select(gene, log_half_life); ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)
  shared <- intersect(intersect(rownames(sc.batch_cor.ab), rownames(rna_abund_log2)), hl$gene)
  prot_sub <- sc.batch_cor.ab[shared, ids$prot_ids, drop = FALSE]
  rna_sub  <- rna_abund_log2[shared, ids$rna_ids, drop = FALSE]
  out <- dplyr::tibble(gene = shared, mean_prot_log2 = rowMeans(prot_sub, na.rm = TRUE),
                       mean_rna_log2 = rowMeans(rna_sub, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(hl, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(mean_prot_log2), is.finite(mean_rna_log2), is.finite(log_half_life))
  if (m4_log_base == "log2") out <- out %>% dplyr::mutate(log_half_life = log_half_life / log(2))
  out$celltype <- ct; out
}
m4_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(m4_celltypes, build_m4_data_one_ct)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Monocytes", "NK cells", "B cells")))
m4_long <- m4_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_prot_log2, mean_rna_log2), names_to = "modality", values_to = "mean_log2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(modality = dplyr::recode(modality, "mean_prot_log2" = "Protein", "mean_rna_log2" = "mRNA"),
                modality = factor(modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")),
                is_ribosomal = gene %in% ribosome_genes,
                point_class = factor(ifelse(is_ribosomal, "Ribosomal gene-products", "All gene-products"),
                                     levels = c("All gene-products", "Ribosomal gene-products")))
m4_stats <- m4_long %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype, modality) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(r = suppressWarnings(cor(log_half_life, mean_log2, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")),
                   n = sum(is.finite(log_half_life) & is.finite(mean_log2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = sprintf("r = %.2f\nn = %d", r, n))
x_lab_m4 <- if (m4_log_base == "log2") {
  expression(log[2]("protein half-life, hours"))
} else {
  "log(protein half-life, hours)"
}

build_m4_column <- function(mod_name, show_celltype_strip, show_y_title) {
  d <- dplyr::filter(m4_long, modality == mod_name); st <- dplyr::filter(m4_stats, modality == mod_name)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = log_half_life, y = mean_log2)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(d, !is_ribosomal), aes(shape = point_class, color = celltype), alpha = 0.35, size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(d, is_ribosomal), aes(shape = point_class, color = celltype), alpha = 0.95, size = 1.4, stroke = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = st, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.2,
              color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c("All gene-products" = 16, "Ribosomal gene-products" = 4)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = celltype_colors, guide = "none") +
    facet_grid(celltype ~ modality, switch = "y") +
    labs(x = x_lab_m4, y = if (show_y_title) expression("Mean log"[2]*" abundance") else NULL) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.8, alpha = 1, color = "black"))) +
    theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60"), strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 6.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  if (!show_celltype_strip) p <- p + theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(), strip.background.y = element_blank())
  p
}

prot_detection_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(m5_celltypes, function(ct) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)$prot_ids; prot_sub <- sc.batch_cor[, ids, drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(gene = rownames(prot_sub), celltype = ct, n_cells_detected = rowSums(!is.na(prot_sub)),
             n_cells_total = length(ids), detection_freq = rowSums(!is.na(prot_sub)) / length(ids), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

within_complex_stats <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_f0))) {
  cx_id <- if ("ComplexID" %in% colnames(corum_f0)) corum_f0$ComplexID[i] else i
  cx_name <- corum_f0[[ribo_name_col]][i]; g_all <- corum_f0$subunit_genes[[i]]; n_annotated <- length(g_all)
  for (ct in m5_celltypes) {
    g_shared_ct <- intersect(g_all, shared_proteins_ct[[ct]]); pct_detected <- length(g_shared_ct) / n_annotated
    if (pct_detected < m5_min_detection_freq_ct || length(g_shared_ct) < m5_min_subunits_detected) next
    ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)
    g_both <- intersect(intersect(g_shared_ct, rownames(sc.batch_cor)), rownames(rna_mat_log2_centered))
    if (length(g_both) < m5_min_subunits_detected) next
    pmat <- sc.batch_cor[g_both, ids$prot_ids, drop = FALSE]
    pcor <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(pmat), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    median_prot_corr <- median(pcor[upper.tri(pcor)], na.rm = TRUE)
    rmat <- rna_mat_log2_centered[g_both, ids$rna_ids, drop = FALSE]
    rcor <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(rmat), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    median_rna_corr <- median(rcor[upper.tri(rcor)], na.rm = TRUE)
    hl_ct <- hl_long %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct, gene %in% g_both)
    within_complex_stats[[length(within_complex_stats) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      complex_id = cx_id, complex_name = cx_name, celltype = ct, n_subunits_annotated = n_annotated,
      n_subunits_detected = length(g_shared_ct), pct_subunits_detected = pct_detected, n_subunits_used = length(g_both),
      median_prot_corr = median_prot_corr, median_rna_corr = median_rna_corr,
      delta_corr = median_prot_corr - median_rna_corr,
      median_log2_hl = if (nrow(hl_ct)) median(hl_ct$log2_half_life, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd_log2_hl = if (nrow(hl_ct) >= 2) sd(hl_ct$log2_half_life, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      n_subunits_hl = nrow(hl_ct), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}

ct_prefix_map <- c("Monocytes" = "Mono", "NK cells" = "NK", "B cells" = "B")

build_annotation_with_r <- function(data, x_col, y_col) {
  .sr <- function(x, y) { ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA_real_); suppressWarnings(cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman")) }
  .sp <- function(x, y) { ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman")$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)) }
  .fp <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "p = NA", ifelse(p < 0.01, sprintf("p = %.0e", p), sprintf("p = %.2f", p)))
  data %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_complexes = dplyr::n(), r_spearman = .sr(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]]),
                     p_spearman = .sp(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("NK cells", "B cells", "Monocytes"))) %>% dplyr::arrange(celltype) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(vjust = 1.4 + (dplyr::row_number() - 1) * 1.4, prefix = ct_prefix_map[as.character(celltype)],
                  label = sprintf("%s: n = %d, r = %.2f, %s", prefix, n_complexes, r_spearman, .fp(p_spearman)))
}

# ── M5a-cross (Panel C): CT-vs-CT within-complex protein corr + BOOTSTRAP ───────
cat("\nM5a-cross — CT-vs-CT within-complex protein correlation + true bootstrap [MF2 C]\n")
panelC_n_boot   <- mf2_params$panelC_n_boot
panelC_frac     <- mf2_params$panelC_boot_frac
panelC_replace  <- mf2_params$panelC_boot_replace
panelC_axis_limit <- mf2_params$panelC_axis_limit

build_complex_gene_sets <- function(ct) {
  out <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(corum_f0))) {
    cx_id <- if ("ComplexID" %in% colnames(corum_f0)) corum_f0$ComplexID[i] else i
    g_all <- corum_f0$subunit_genes[[i]]; n_annotated <- length(g_all)
    g_shared_ct <- intersect(g_all, shared_proteins_ct[[ct]])
    if (length(g_shared_ct) / n_annotated < m5_min_detection_freq_ct || length(g_shared_ct) < m5_min_subunits_detected) next
    g_both <- intersect(intersect(g_shared_ct, rownames(sc.batch_cor)), rownames(rna_mat_log2_centered))
    if (length(g_both) < m5_min_subunits_detected) next
    out[[as.character(cx_id)]] <- g_both
  }
  out
}
median_within_complex_prot <- function(genes, cells) {
  if (length(genes) < 2 || length(cells) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  pcor <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(sc.batch_cor[genes, cells, drop = FALSE]), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  median(pcor[upper.tri(pcor)], na.rm = TRUE)
}
# Returns an n_complex x n_boot matrix of per-iteration complex medians for this ct.
bootstrap_complex_medians_ct <- function(ct, gene_sets, n_boot, frac, replace) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)$prot_ids; n_draw <- max(3L, round(length(ids) * frac)); cx_ids <- names(gene_sets)
  boot_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(cx_ids), ncol = n_boot, dimnames = list(cx_ids, NULL))
  for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    cells_b <- sample(ids, n_draw, replace = replace)
    for (k in seq_along(cx_ids)) boot_mat[k, b] <- median_within_complex_prot(gene_sets[[cx_ids[k]]], cells_b)
  }
  boot_mat
}
panelC_celltypes <- c("CD4 T cells", "CD8 T cells", "B cells")
set.seed(mf2_params$panelC_seed)   # LOCAL — reproducibility only
panelC_gene_sets <- lapply(panelC_celltypes, build_complex_gene_sets); names(panelC_gene_sets) <- panelC_celltypes
panelC_boot_medians <- lapply(panelC_celltypes, function(ct) {
  cat(sprintf("    %-12s: %d complexes\n", ct, length(panelC_gene_sets[[ct]])))
  bootstrap_complex_medians_ct(ct, panelC_gene_sets[[ct]], panelC_n_boot, panelC_frac, panelC_replace)
})
names(panelC_boot_medians) <- panelC_celltypes

# Per-cell-type point estimate (full-data median) + 2.5/97.5 percentile interval.
panelC_full_wide <- m5_corum_stats %>% dplyr::filter(celltype %in% panelC_celltypes) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(complex_id = as.character(complex_id)) %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, celltype, median_prot_corr) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = median_prot_corr)

panelC_ci_wide <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(panelC_celltypes, function(ct) {
  bm <- panelC_boot_medians[[ct]]
  data.frame(complex_id = rownames(bm), celltype = ct,
             lo = apply(bm, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
             hi = apply(bm, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = c(lo, hi),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{celltype}")

build_ct_vs_ct_scatter_boot <- function(full_wide, ci_wide, boot_medians, x_ct, y_ct,
                                        n_boot, sig_fdr = 0.05,
                                        xlim = c(-0.1, 0.4), ylim = c(-0.1, 0.4),
                                        arp23_ids = NULL) {
  lo_x <- paste0("lo_", x_ct); hi_x <- paste0("hi_", x_ct)
  lo_y <- paste0("lo_", y_ct); hi_y <- paste0("hi_", y_ct)
  d <- full_wide %>% dplyr::left_join(ci_wide, by = "complex_id") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[x_ct]]), is.finite(.data[[y_ct]]))

  # Per-complex bootstrap difference (x_ct - y_ct): percentile CI + two-sided p, BH.
  bm_x <- boot_medians[[x_ct]]; bm_y <- boot_medians[[y_ct]]
  diff_stats <- lapply(d$complex_id, function(cid) {
    dx <- bm_x[cid, ]; dy <- bm_y[cid, ]
    delta <- dx - dy; delta <- delta[is.finite(delta)]
    if (length(delta) < max(20L, 0.5 * n_boot)) return(data.frame(complex_id = cid,
      diff_lo = NA_real_, diff_hi = NA_real_, boot_p = NA_real_))
    p_raw <- 2 * min(mean(delta <= 0), mean(delta >= 0))
    p_raw <- max(p_raw, 1 / length(delta))        # floor at resolution
    data.frame(complex_id = cid,
               diff_lo = quantile(delta, 0.025, names = FALSE),
               diff_hi = quantile(delta, 0.975, names = FALSE),
               boot_p  = min(p_raw, 1))
  })
  diff_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(diff_stats)
  diff_stats$boot_fdr <- p.adjust(diff_stats$boot_p, method = "BH")
  d <- dplyr::left_join(d, diff_stats, by = "complex_id")

  n_common <- nrow(d)
  n_sig <- sum(d$boot_fdr < sig_fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  %s vs %s: %d common complexes | %d significant (BH<%.2f)\n",
              x_ct, y_ct, n_common, n_sig, sig_fdr))
  r_val <- cor(d[[x_ct]], d[[y_ct]], method = "pearson")
  annot <- sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f\nn = %d complexes\nn = %d < 5%% FDR",
                   r_val, n_common, n_sig)

  d <- d %>% dplyr::mutate(
    .sig = !is.na(boot_fdr) & boot_fdr < sig_fdr,
    point_color = ifelse(.sig, "red", "grey60"),
    is_arp23 = if (!is.null(arp23_ids)) complex_id %in% arp23_ids else FALSE
  )

  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_ct]], y = .data[[y_ct]])) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(data = dplyr::filter(d, .sig),
                  aes(ymin = .data[[lo_y]], ymax = .data[[hi_y]]),
                  color = "black", width = 0, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1) +
    geom_errorbarh(data = dplyr::filter(d, .sig),
                   aes(xmin = .data[[lo_x]], xmax = .data[[hi_x]]),
                   color = "black", height = 0, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(color = point_color), size = 0.98, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(d, is_arp23), shape = 1, color = "black", size = 2.2, stroke = 0.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(d, is_arp23), aes(label = "Arp2/3"),
                             color = "black", size = 1.8, fontface = "bold",
                             box.padding = 0.6, point.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0,
                             segment.color = "black", segment.size = 0.3,
                             nudge_x = 0.06, nudge_y = 0.06, seed = 42) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = annot, hjust = -0.06, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.0, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, clip = "off") +
    labs(x = x_ct, y = y_ct) +
    theme_light(base_size = 6.5) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 2, 2))
}

arp23_pairwise <- function(mat, genes, cells) {
  g <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat)); sub <- mat[g, cells, drop = FALSE]
  detected <- g[rowSums(!is.na(sub)) > 0]
  if (length(detected) < 2) return(list(cor = numeric(0), n_detected = length(detected)))
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(sub[detected, , drop = FALSE]), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  vals <- cmat[upper.tri(cmat)]; list(cor = vals[is.finite(vals)], n_detected = length(detected))
}
arp23_rows <- list(); arp23_detect <- list()
for (ct in celltype_order) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)
  pr <- arp23_pairwise(sc.batch_cor, arp23_genes, ids$prot_ids)
  rn <- arp23_pairwise(rna_mat_log2_centered, arp23_genes, ids$rna_ids)
  if (length(pr$cor)) arp23_rows[[length(arp23_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, modality = "Protein", r = pr$cor, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (length(rn$cor)) arp23_rows[[length(arp23_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, modality = "mRNA", r = rn$cor, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  arp23_detect[[length(arp23_detect) + 1L]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct,
                                                          Protein_pct = 100 * pr$n_detected / length(arp23_genes), mRNA_pct = 100 * rn$n_detected / length(arp23_genes), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

partial_spearman_tbl <- function(df, xvar, yvar, sizevar, abundvar) {
  if (!m6_have_ppcor) return(NULL)
  df <- droplevels(df)
  split(df, df$celltype) %>% lapply(function(dd) {
    keep <- complete.cases(dd[, c(xvar, yvar, sizevar, abundvar)]); dd <- dd[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(dd) < 5) return(NULL)
    sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(dd[[xvar]], dd[[yvar]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    psp_size <- suppressWarnings(ppcor::pcor.test(x = dd[[xvar]], y = dd[[yvar]], z = dd[[sizevar]], method = "spearman"))
    psp_both <- suppressWarnings(ppcor::pcor.test(x = dd[[xvar]], y = dd[[yvar]], z = dd[, c(sizevar, abundvar), drop = FALSE], method = "spearman"))
    data.frame(celltype = as.character(unique(dd$celltype)), n_complexes = nrow(dd),
               spearman_r = unname(sp$estimate), spearman_p = sp$p.value,
               partial_r_size = psp_size$estimate, partial_p_size = psp_size$p.value,
               partial_r_size_abundance = psp_both$estimate, partial_p_size_abundance = psp_both$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
}
m6_e_partial_tbl <- partial_spearman_tbl(m6_e_data, "median_log2_hl", "median_prot_corr", "n_subunits_used", "median_subunit_log2_ab")
m6_f_partial_tbl <- partial_spearman_tbl(m6_f_data, "sd_log2_hl", "median_prot_corr", "n_subunits_hl", "median_subunit_log2_ab")

build_m6_partial_table_single <- function(tbl, title_text) {
  if (is.null(tbl)) { cat("  [M6.6] partial table NULL — panel skipped.\n"); return(NULL) }
  fmt_r <- function(r) sprintf("%.2f", r)
  stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
  df <- tbl %>% dplyr::transmute(celltype, `n complexes` = as.character(n_complexes),
                                 `Raw r` = paste0(fmt_r(spearman_r), stars(spearman_p)),
                                 `Partial r | size` = paste0(fmt_r(partial_r_size), stars(partial_p_size)),
                                 `Partial r | size+abund` = paste0(fmt_r(partial_r_size_abundance), stars(partial_p_size_abundance))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Monocytes", "NK cells", "B cells"))) %>% dplyr::arrange(celltype)
  long <- df %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(`n complexes`, `Raw r`, `Partial r | size`, `Partial r | size+abund`),
                                     names_to = "Column", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Column = factor(Column, levels = c("n complexes", "Raw r", "Partial r | size", "Partial r | size+abund")))
  ggplot(long, aes(x = Column, y = celltype)) +
    geom_tile(fill = "white", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_text(aes(label = value), size = 2.0) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c("Monocytes", "NK cells", "B cells"))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title_text, subtitle = "Stars: * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001") +
    theme_void(base_size = 7) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 1, color = "grey20"),
          plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
}
p_sf4_m6_table_medianHL <- build_m6_partial_table_single(m6_e_partial_tbl,
                                                         "Partial Spearman: median log2 protein half-life per complex vs median within-complex pairwise protein correlation")
