```{r, Script 6}
# ── M5-Arp23-STRING: Arp2/3 <-> STRING physical-partner correlations [MF2 F bottom] ──
cat("\nM5-Arp23-STRING — Arp2/3 direct-partner correlations [MF2 F bottom]\n")
arp_string_params <- list(
  cell_types = c("Monocytes", "NK cells", "CD8 T cells", "CD4 T cells", "B cells"), subunit_order = NULL,
  string_version = "12.0", string_species = 9606, string_score_thr = 400, string_network = "physical",
  require_exp_db = TRUE, cor_method = "pearson", min_pairwise_obs = 100, heat_limit = 0.5,
  string_cache_dir = file.path(reference_db_dir, "stringdb_cache"))
arp_subunits <- if (exists("arp23_genes") && length(arp23_genes) > 0) arp23_genes else
  c("ACTR2", "ACTR3", "ARPC1A", "ARPC1B", "ARPC2", "ARPC3", "ARPC4", "ARPC5")
subunit_order <- if (is.null(arp_string_params$subunit_order)) arp_subunits else arp_string_params$subunit_order

stopifnot(requireNamespace("STRINGdb", quietly = TRUE))
if (!dir.exists(arp_string_params$string_cache_dir))
  dir.create(arp_string_params$string_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sdb <- STRINGdb::STRINGdb$new(version = arp_string_params$string_version, species = arp_string_params$string_species,
                              score_threshold = arp_string_params$string_score_thr, network_type = arp_string_params$string_network,
                              input_directory = arp_string_params$string_cache_dir)
arp_map <- sdb$map(data.frame(gene = arp_subunits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)
arp_ids <- unique(arp_map$STRING_id)
proteins <- sdb$get_proteins(); id2sym <- setNames(proteins$preferred_name, proteins$protein_external_id)
neighbor_ids <- sdb$get_neighbors(arp_ids); all_ids <- union(arp_ids, neighbor_ids); ix <- sdb$get_interactions(all_ids)
exp_cols <- grep("^experiments", colnames(ix), value = TRUE); db_cols <- grep("^database", colnames(ix), value = TRUE)
have_channels <- length(c(exp_cols, db_cols)) > 0
edges <- ix %>% dplyr::filter(combined_score >= arp_string_params$string_score_thr) %>% dplyr::filter(from %in% arp_ids | to %in% arp_ids)
if (arp_string_params$require_exp_db && have_channels) {
  edges$exp_db <- rowSums(edges[, c(exp_cols, db_cols), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE); edges <- dplyr::filter(edges, exp_db > 0)
}
partner_ids <- setdiff(unique(c(edges$from, edges$to)), arp_ids)
partner_genes <- unique(unname(id2sym[partner_ids]))
partner_genes <- partner_genes[!is.na(partner_genes) & partner_genes != "" & !(partner_genes %in% arp_subunits)]
partner_genes <- intersect(partner_genes, rownames(sc.batch_cor))
cat(sprintf("  STRING physical partners quantified: %d\n", length(partner_genes)))

arp_partner_cor_ct <- function(ct, arp_g, part_g, mat, method) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)$prot_ids; use <- intersect(c(arp_g, part_g), rownames(mat)); sub <- mat[use, ids, drop = FALSE]
  cm <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(sub), method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")); nm <- get_pairwise_n(sub)
  ag <- intersect(arp_g, rownames(sub)); pg <- intersect(part_g, rownames(sub)); if (!length(ag) || !length(pg)) return(NULL)
  grid <- expand.grid(subunit = ag, partner = pg, KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  grid$celltype <- ct; grid$r <- cm[cbind(grid$subunit, grid$partner)]; grid$n <- nm[cbind(grid$subunit, grid$partner)]; grid
}
cor_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(arp_string_params$cell_types, arp_partner_cor_ct,
                                    arp_g = arp_subunits, part_g = partner_genes, mat = sc.batch_cor, method = arp_string_params$cor_method))
n_ct <- length(arp_string_params$cell_types)
common_subunits <- cor_long %>% dplyr::distinct(subunit, celltype) %>% dplyr::count(subunit) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n == n_ct) %>% dplyr::pull(subunit)
common_subunits <- intersect(subunit_order, common_subunits)
cor_use <- dplyr::filter(cor_long, subunit %in% common_subunits); needed <- length(common_subunits) * n_ct
retained_partners <- cor_use %>% dplyr::filter(n >= arp_string_params$min_pairwise_obs) %>%
  dplyr::count(partner) %>% dplyr::filter(n == needed) %>% dplyr::pull(partner)
stopifnot(length(retained_partners) >= 2, length(common_subunits) >= 1)

# ── M5-Arp23-BG: proteome-wide background for percentile annotation ──────────────────
cat("\nM5-Arp23-BG — proteome background for STRING percentile annotation\n")

arp_bg_params <- list(
  det_frac   = 0.40,
  min_coobs  = arp_string_params$min_pairwise_obs,   
  hi_thr     = c(0.95, 0.90, 0.85),                  
  lo_thr     = c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15)                   
)

arp_bg_cts      <- arp_string_params$cell_types
arp_bg_subunits <- common_subunits                   

arp_bg_eligible <- lapply(arp_bg_cts, function(ct) {
  ids  <- get_celltype_cells(ct)$prot_ids
  m    <- sc.batch_cor[, ids, drop = FALSE]
  cand <- rownames(m)[rowMeans(!is.na(m)) >= arp_bg_params$det_frac]
  cand <- setdiff(cand, arp_bg_subunits)
  su   <- intersect(arp_bg_subunits, rownames(m))
  ob_c <- !is.na(m[cand, , drop = FALSE]); storage.mode(ob_c) <- "integer"
  ob_s <- !is.na(m[su,   , drop = FALSE]); storage.mode(ob_s) <- "integer"
  nmat <- ob_c %*% t(ob_s)                           
  keep <- cand[rowSums(nmat >= arp_bg_params$min_coobs) == length(su)]
  cat(sprintf("    %-12s: %5d cells | %5d pass %.0f%% detection | %5d also >= %d co-obs vs all %d subunits\n",
              ct, length(ids), length(cand), 100 * arp_bg_params$det_frac,
              length(keep), arp_bg_params$min_coobs, length(su)))
  keep
})
names(arp_bg_eligible) <- arp_bg_cts

arp_bg_genes <- Reduce(intersect, arp_bg_eligible)
cat(sprintf("  Shared background set (all %d cell types): %d gene-products\n",
            length(arp_bg_cts), length(arp_bg_genes)))
stopifnot(length(arp_bg_genes) >= 50)

# Diagnostic: are the plotted STRING partners inside the background set?
arp_bg_missing_partners <- setdiff(retained_partners, arp_bg_genes)
cat(sprintf("  STRING partners in heatmap: %d | of these inside background: %d | outside: %d\n",
            length(retained_partners),
            length(intersect(retained_partners, arp_bg_genes)),
            length(arp_bg_missing_partners)))
if (length(arp_bg_missing_partners))
  cat(sprintf("    outside background (ranked against better-detected proteins): %s\n",
              paste(arp_bg_missing_partners, collapse = ", ")))

# Background correlations, recomputed per cell type on the shared set.
arp_bg_cor_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(arp_bg_cts, function(ct) {
  ids <- get_celltype_cells(ct)$prot_ids
  bg  <- sc.batch_cor[arp_bg_genes,    ids, drop = FALSE]
  su  <- sc.batch_cor[arp_bg_subunits, ids, drop = FALSE]
  r   <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(bg), t(su),
                             method = arp_string_params$cor_method,
                             use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  ob_b <- !is.na(bg); storage.mode(ob_b) <- "integer"
  ob_s <- !is.na(su); storage.mode(ob_s) <- "integer"
  r[(ob_b %*% t(ob_s)) < arp_bg_params$min_coobs] <- NA_real_   
  data.frame(celltype = ct,
             gene    = rep(rownames(r), times = ncol(r)),
             subunit = rep(colnames(r), each  = nrow(r)),
             r       = as.vector(r), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(r))

cat("  Background correlations per cell type x subunit:\n")
print(arp_bg_cor_long %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype, subunit) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), median_r = round(median(r), 3),
                         q85 = round(quantile(r, 0.85), 3),
                         q95 = round(quantile(r, 0.95), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
        as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)

row_levels <- unlist(lapply(arp_string_params$cell_types, function(ct) paste(ct, common_subunits, sep = " | ")))
hm_long <- cor_use %>% dplyr::filter(partner %in% retained_partners) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(row = factor(paste(celltype, subunit, sep = " | "), levels = row_levels))
mat_wide <- reshape2::dcast(hm_long, row ~ partner, value.var = "r")
rownames(mat_wide) <- as.character(mat_wide$row); mat_wide$row <- NULL
mat_hm <- as.matrix(mat_wide)[row_levels, , drop = FALSE]

# ── M5-Arp23-BG: percentile rank of each plotted correlation + star glyphs ───────────
arp_bg_ecdf <- split(arp_bg_cor_long$r,
                     paste(arp_bg_cor_long$celltype, arp_bg_cor_long$subunit, sep = "\r"))
arp_bg_ecdf <- lapply(arp_bg_ecdf, stats::ecdf)

arp_star_of <- function(p) {
  h <- arp_bg_params$hi_thr; l <- arp_bg_params$lo_thr
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p)   ~ "",
    p >= h[1]  ~ "***", p >= h[2] ~ "**", p >= h[3] ~ "*",
    p <= l[1]  ~ "***", p <= l[2] ~ "**", p <= l[3] ~ "*",
    TRUE       ~ "")
}

hm_pct <- hm_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    .key = paste(celltype, subunit, sep = "\r"),
    pct  = mapply(function(k, v) if (!is.null(arp_bg_ecdf[[k]]) && is.finite(v))
      arp_bg_ecdf[[k]](v) else NA_real_, .key, r),
    stars = arp_star_of(pct),
    tail  = dplyr::case_when(is.na(pct) ~ NA_character_,
                             pct >= arp_bg_params$hi_thr[3] ~ "upper",
                             pct <= arp_bg_params$lo_thr[3] ~ "lower",
                             TRUE ~ "middle"))

arp_star_mat <- matrix("", nrow(mat_hm), ncol(mat_hm), dimnames = dimnames(mat_hm))
.ij <- cbind(match(paste(hm_pct$celltype, hm_pct$subunit, sep = " | "), rownames(arp_star_mat)),
             match(hm_pct$partner, colnames(arp_star_mat)))
.ok <- !is.na(.ij[, 1]) & !is.na(.ij[, 2])
arp_star_mat[.ij[.ok, , drop = FALSE]] <- hm_pct$stars[.ok]

cat(sprintf("\n  Starred heatmap cells: %d / %d (%.1f%%) | upper tail %d, lower tail %d\n",
            sum(nzchar(arp_star_mat)), length(arp_star_mat),
            100 * sum(nzchar(arp_star_mat)) / length(arp_star_mat),
            sum(hm_pct$tail == "upper", na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(hm_pct$tail == "lower", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat("  >> FOR TEXT: upper-tail enrichment vs the 15% expected by construction\n")
print(hm_pct %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(),
                         median_pct = round(median(pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                         frac_upper = round(mean(tail == "upper", na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                         frac_lower = round(mean(tail == "lower", na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                         .groups = "drop") %>% as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)

# ── M5-Arp23-HEATMAP: color scale, row split/labels, left annotation ─────────────────
L <- arp_string_params$heat_limit

stopifnot(is.matrix(mat_hm), nrow(mat_hm) > 0, ncol(mat_hm) > 0,
          identical(rownames(mat_hm), row_levels))

# Diverging scale saturating at +/- L; matches the triangle heatmaps in M7.
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-L, 0, L), c("blue", "white", "red"))

# Row names are "<cell type> | <subunit>" (built as row_levels above). Split rows by
# cell type so each block is titled, and label individual rows by subunit only.
.row_parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(rownames(mat_hm), " | ", fixed = TRUE))
stopifnot(ncol(.row_parts) == 2)
row_ct  <- factor(.row_parts[, 1], levels = arp_string_params$cell_types)
row_lab <- .row_parts[, 2]
stopifnot(!anyNA(row_ct), all(levels(row_ct) %in% names(celltype_colors)))

# Partner gene names on the x-axis are informative; keep them.
show_cols <- TRUE

left_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  celltype = row_ct,
  col = list(celltype = celltype_colors[levels(row_ct)]),
  show_legend          = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size     = unit(1.5, "mm")
)

cat(sprintf("  Heatmap matrix: %d rows (%d cell types x %d subunits) x %d partners\n",
            nrow(mat_hm), nlevels(row_ct), length(common_subunits), ncol(mat_hm)))
cat(sprintf("  Correlation range: %.3f to %.3f (scale saturates at +/- %.2f)\n",
            min(mat_hm, na.rm = TRUE), max(mat_hm, na.rm = TRUE), L))
ht_arp_string <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(mat_hm, name = "Pearson r", col = col_fun, na_col = "grey85",
                                         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = TRUE, clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
                                         show_column_dend = FALSE,
                                         row_split = row_ct, row_gap = unit(1.0, "mm"), row_title_rot = 0, row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "bold"),
                                         row_labels = row_lab, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4), show_column_names = show_cols,
                                         column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4), column_names_rot = 45, left_annotation = left_anno,
                                         column_title = "STRING-annotated Arp2/3 complex interactors",
                                         column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold"),
                                         cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                                           lbl <- arp_star_mat[i, j]
                                           if (!is.na(lbl) && nzchar(lbl)) {
                                             grid::grid.text(lbl, x, y, vjust = 0.78,
                                                             gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 4.5, fontface = "bold", col = "black"))
                                           }
                                         },
                                         heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c(-L, 0, L), labels = c(paste0("\u2264 -", L), "0", paste0("\u2265 ", L)),
                                                                     direction = "vertical",
                                                                     title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5.5),
                                                                     grid_height = unit(2.5, "mm"), grid_width = unit(2.5, "mm")))


# ══ M7  Correlation-module analysis — shared machinery + B-cell run [MF2 G ; SF4B A/B]
cat("\nM7 — B-cell correlation-module analysis [MF2 G ; SF4B A/B]\n")
set.seed(42)   # LOCAL

P <- list(det = 0.60, minvar = 1e-10, wthr = 0.15, mcs = 10, ds_within = 1.5)

rna_mat <- rna_mat_log2_centered

prot_ct <- tibble::tibble(cell = colnames(sc.batch_cor),
                          celltype = cell_types_df$CellType[match(colnames(sc.batch_cor), cell_types_df$Cell)]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype), celltype != "Dendritic cells")
rna_ct <- tibble::tibble(cell = rna_celltypes_full$cell_id, celltype = rna_celltypes_full$celltype)

get_unit <- function(unit) {
  pc <- dplyr::filter(prot_ct, celltype == unit); rc <- dplyr::filter(rna_ct, celltype == unit)
  list(prot = sc.batch_cor[, pc$cell, drop = FALSE], rna = rna_mat[, rc$cell, drop = FALSE],
       prot_cells = pc$cell, rna_cells = rc$cell)
}
row_var <- function(x) { n <- rowSums(!is.na(x)); m <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
v <- rowSums((x - m)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / (n - 1); v[n < 2] <- NA_real_; v }
detect_pass <- function(prot_mat, thr = P$det) rownames(prot_mat)[rowMeans(!is.na(prot_mat)) >= thr]
pearson_cor <- function(m) { r <- cor(t(m), use = "pairwise.complete.obs"); diag(r) <- 1; r }
cut_modules <- function(r, deep_split, mcs = P$mcs) {
  r0 <- r; r0[is.na(r0)] <- 0; diag(r0) <- 1; dm <- 1 - r0
  hc <- hclust(as.dist(dm), "ward.D2")
  lab <- dynamicTreeCut::cutreeDynamic(hc, distM = dm, method = "hybrid", deepSplit = deep_split,
                                       minClusterSize = mcs, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, verbose = 0)
  names(lab) <- colnames(r0); lab[lab != 0]
}
clusters_to_sets <- function(cl) split(names(cl), cl)
median_within <- function(genes, r) { if (length(genes) < 2) return(NA_real_); s <- r[genes, genes, drop = FALSE]; median(s[lower.tri(s)], na.rm = TRUE) }

identify_modules <- function(prot_mat, rna_mat, deep_split, det = P$det, minvar = P$minvar, wthr = P$wthr, mcs = P$mcs) {
  shared <- intersect(detect_pass(prot_mat, det), rownames(rna_mat)); if (length(shared) < mcs * 2) return(NULL)
  pv <- row_var(prot_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE]); rv <- row_var(rna_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE])
  shared <- shared[is.finite(pv) & is.finite(rv) & pv > minvar & rv > minvar]; if (length(shared) < mcs * 2) return(NULL)
  pc <- pearson_cor(prot_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE]); rc <- pearson_cor(rna_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE])
  keep_modular <- function(cl, r) { if (!length(cl)) return(character(0)); s <- clusters_to_sets(cl)
  unique(unlist(s[vapply(s, function(g) isTRUE(median_within(g, r) >= wthr), logical(1))], use.names = FALSE)) }
  union_genes <- union(keep_modular(cut_modules(pc, deep_split, mcs), pc), keep_modular(cut_modules(rc, deep_split, mcs), rc))
  if (length(union_genes) < mcs * 2) return(NULL)
  pc2 <- pc[union_genes, union_genes, drop = FALSE]; rc2 <- rc[union_genes, union_genes, drop = FALSE]
  list(prot_clusters = cut_modules(pc2, deep_split, mcs), rna_clusters = cut_modules(rc2, deep_split, mcs),
       prot_cor = pc2, rna_cor = rc2, union_genes = union_genes)
}
annotate_module <- function(genes, bg, sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG", "REAC")) {
  if (!requireNamespace("gprofiler2", quietly = TRUE)) return(NULL); if (length(genes) < 3) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(gprofiler2::gost(genes, organism = "hsapiens", custom_bg = bg, domain_scope = "custom",
                                   sources = sources, correction_method = "fdr"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$result) || !nrow(res$result)) return(NULL)
  x <- res$result %>% dplyr::mutate(fdr_tier = dplyr::case_when(p_value < 0.01 ~ 1, p_value < 0.05 ~ 2, p_value < 0.10 ~ 3, TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(fdr_tier)); if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  x %>% dplyr::mutate(coverage = intersection_size / term_size) %>% dplyr::arrange(fdr_tier, dplyr::desc(coverage), p_value) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::select(source, term_name, p_value, coverage, fdr_tier)
}
module_labels <- function(clusters, bg, sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG", "REAC")) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(clusters_to_sets(clusters), function(g, mid) {
    ann <- annotate_module(g, bg, sources = sources)
    if (is.null(ann)) return(tibble::tibble(module = mid, term = NA_character_, source = NA_character_, p_value = NA_real_, coverage = NA_real_, fdr_tier = NA_real_))
    tibble::tibble(module = mid, term = ann$term_name, source = ann$source, p_value = ann$p_value, coverage = ann$coverage, fdr_tier = ann$fdr_tier)
  })
}
sil_one <- function(cl, r) { g <- names(cl)
if (length(unique(cl)) < 2) return(tibble::tibble(gene = g, module = unname(cl), sil_width = NA_real_))
s <- r[g, g]; s[is.na(s)] <- 0; diag(s) <- 1; z <- cluster::silhouette(as.integer(factor(cl)), as.dist(1 - s))
tibble::tibble(gene = g, module = unname(cl), sil_width = z[, "sil_width"]) }
conn_one <- function(cl, r, use_abs = FALSE) {
  g <- names(cl); n <- length(g); cl <- unname(cl); s <- r[g, g]; if (use_abs) s <- abs(s)
  intra <- inter <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (k in seq_len(n)) { own <- cl == cl[k]; same <- own; same[k] <- FALSE
  if (any(same)) intra[k] <- mean(s[k, same], na.rm = TRUE); if (any(!own)) inter[k] <- mean(s[k, !own], na.rm = TRUE) }
  tibble::tibble(gene = g, module = cl, intra_conn = intra, inter_conn = inter, conn_diff = intra - inter) }
module_quality <- function(mod, prot_lab, rna_lab) {
  sil <- dplyr::bind_rows(sil_one(mod$prot_clusters, mod$prot_cor) %>% dplyr::mutate(modality = "protein"),
                          sil_one(mod$rna_clusters, mod$rna_cor) %>% dplyr::mutate(modality = "mRNA"))
  conn <- dplyr::bind_rows(conn_one(mod$prot_clusters, mod$prot_cor) %>% dplyr::mutate(modality = "protein"),
                           conn_one(mod$rna_clusters, mod$rna_cor) %>% dplyr::mutate(modality = "mRNA"))
  summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(list(protein = mod$prot_clusters, mRNA = mod$rna_clusters), function(cl, modality) {
    lab <- if (modality == "protein") prot_lab else rna_lab
    purrr::imap_dfr(clusters_to_sets(cl), function(g, mid) tibble::tibble(modality = modality, module = mid, module_size = length(g),
                                                                          top_go_bp = lab$term[match(mid, lab$module)], within_r_prot = median_within(g, mod$prot_cor), within_r_rna = median_within(g, mod$rna_cor),
                                                                          delta_r = median_within(g, mod$prot_cor) - median_within(g, mod$rna_cor),
                                                                          median_sil = median(sil$sil_width[sil$modality == modality & sil$module == as.integer(mid)], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                          median_conn_diff = median(conn$conn_diff[conn$modality == modality & conn$module == as.integer(mid)], na.rm = TRUE))) })
  list(silhouette = sil, connectivity = conn, summary = summary)
}
triangle_heatmap <- function(prot_cor, rna_cor, clusters, unit_label = "B cells",
                             legend_direction = "horizontal", legend_position = "bottom",
                             gene_order = NULL, module_labels_lookup = NULL) {
  lv <- sort(unique(clusters))
  if (is.null(gene_order)) { cf <- factor(clusters, levels = lv); g <- names(clusters)[order(cf)]; cf <- cf[order(cf)] }
  else { g <- gene_order; cf <- factor(clusters[g], levels = lv) }
  n <- length(g); pr <- prot_cor[g, g]; rr <- rna_cor[g, g]
  m <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n); m[lower.tri(m)] <- pr[lower.tri(pr)]; m[upper.tri(m)] <- rr[upper.tri(rr)]
  df <- data.frame(row = as.vector(row(m)), col = as.vector(col(m)), r = as.vector(m)); df <- df[!is.na(df$r), , drop = FALSE]; df$ypos <- n - df$row + 1
  sizes <- as.integer(table(cf)); bounds <- cumsum(sizes); centers <- bounds - sizes / 2 + 0.5
  sep_row <- bounds[-length(bounds)] + 0.5; sep_x <- sep_row; sep_y <- n - sep_row + 1; centers_y <- n - centers + 1
  

  if (is.null(module_labels_lookup)) {
    mod_labels <- paste0("M", lv)
  } else {
    .trunc_term <- function(s, k = 26) ifelse(!is.na(s) & nchar(s) > k, paste0(substr(s, 1, k - 1), "\u2026"), s)
    term_for <- setNames(as.character(module_labels_lookup$term), as.character(module_labels_lookup$module))
    terms_lv <- unname(term_for[as.character(lv)])
    mod_labels <- ifelse(is.na(terms_lv) | terms_lv == "", paste0("M", lv),
                         paste0("M", lv, ": ", .trunc_term(terms_lv)))
  }
  
  sep_layers <- if (length(sep_row)) list(geom_vline(xintercept = sep_x, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
                                          geom_hline(yintercept = sep_y, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3)) else NULL
  ggplot(df, aes(col, ypos, fill = r)) + geom_tile() + sep_layers +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkblue", mid = "white", high = "#CE2029", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.4, 0.4),
                         oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey85", name = "Pearson r", breaks = c(-0.4, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.4),
                         labels = c("\u2264 -0.4", "-0.2", "0", "0.2", "\u2265 0.4")) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = sprintf("%s, %d gene-products", unit_label, n), breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0),
                       sec.axis = dup_axis(name = "mRNA correlations", breaks = NULL)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Protein correlations", breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0),
                       sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., breaks = centers_y, labels = mod_labels)) +
    coord_equal() +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(direction = legend_direction, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                 barwidth = if (legend_direction == "vertical") grid::unit(2.5, "mm") else grid::unit(28, "mm"),
                                 barheight = if (legend_direction == "vertical") grid::unit(28, "mm") else grid::unit(2.5, "mm"))) +
    theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = legend_position, panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = if (is.null(module_labels_lookup)) 6 else 5),
          axis.title.x.top = element_text(size = 8, colour = modality_colors[["mRNA"]], face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size = 7.5),
          axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 8, colour = modality_colors[["Protein"]], face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
}
heatmap_module_order <- function(clusters) as.character(sort(unique(clusters)))
within_box <- function(clusters, prot_cor, rna_cor, labels, module_order = NULL, legend_position = "bottom") {
  if (is.null(module_order)) module_order <- as.character(sort(unique(clusters)))
  long <- purrr::imap_dfr(clusters_to_sets(clusters), function(g, mid) { pr <- prot_cor[g, g]; rr <- rna_cor[g, g]
  dplyr::bind_rows(tibble::tibble(module = mid, modality = "Protein", r = pr[lower.tri(pr)]),
                   tibble::tibble(module = mid, modality = "mRNA", r = rr[lower.tri(rr)])) }) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(labels, by = "module") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lab = ifelse(is.na(term), paste0("M", module), paste0("M", module, ": ", term)),
                  modality = factor(modality, levels = c("mRNA", "Protein")))
  lk <- dplyr::distinct(long, module, lab); lvl <- lk$lab[match(module_order, lk$module)]; long$lab <- factor(long$lab, levels = rev(lvl))
  ggplot(long, aes(x = lab, y = r, fill = modality)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3, position = position_dodge(0.75)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = modality_colors) + coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Within-module\nPearson r", fill = NULL) +
    theme_light(base_size = 7) + theme(legend.position = legend_position, legend.direction = "horizontal",
                                       axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
                                       legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
annotation_barplot <- function(labels, module_order, title = NULL) {
  labels <- labels %>% dplyr::mutate(score = -log10(p_value), source = factor(source, levels = c("GO:BP", "KEGG", "REAC")),
                                     module = factor(module, levels = rev(module_order)))
  ggplot(labels, aes(x = score, y = module, fill = source)) + geom_col() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GO:BP" = "black", "KEGG" = "grey50", "REAC" = "grey80"), drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) + labs(x = expression(-log[10](FDR)), y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_light(base_size = 7) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
                                       axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1),
                                       legend.direction = "vertical", legend.text = element_text(size = 4.5), legend.key.size = unit(1.875, "mm"),
                                       legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.6), color = NA), legend.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
assemble_panel <- function(heatmap, box, labels, module_order) {
  heatmap + (box + annotation_barplot(labels, module_order) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.75))) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.25, 1))
}
.qual_mod_factor <- function(x) factor(as.integer(x), levels = rev(sort(unique(as.integer(x)))))
quality_silhouette_plot <- function(qual, mod, ylab = NULL) {
  fill <- if (mod == "mRNA") modality_colors[["mRNA"]] else modality_colors[["Protein"]]
  xr <- range(qual$silhouette$sil_width, na.rm = TRUE)
  d <- qual$silhouette %>% dplyr::filter(modality == mod, !is.na(sil_width)) %>% dplyr::mutate(module = .qual_mod_factor(module))
  mu <- mean(d$sil_width, na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = sil_width, y = module)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = fill, outlier.size = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = mu, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xr) + labs(x = "Silhouette width", y = ylab) + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
quality_connectivity_plot <- function(qual, mod, ylab = NULL) {
  allconn <- qual$connectivity %>% dplyr::group_by(modality, module) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(intra = median(intra_conn, na.rm = TRUE), inter = median(inter_conn, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  xr <- range(c(allconn$intra, allconn$inter), na.rm = TRUE)
  d <- allconn %>% dplyr::filter(modality == mod) %>% dplyr::mutate(module = .qual_mod_factor(module))
  ggplot(d, aes(y = module)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = inter, xend = intra, yend = module), color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(x = inter, color = "inter-module"), size = 1.2) + geom_point(aes(x = intra, color = "intra-module"), size = 1.2) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xr) + scale_color_manual(values = c("intra-module" = "#CE2029", "inter-module" = "grey50")) +
    labs(x = "Median connectivity (Pearson r)", y = ylab, color = NULL) + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
quality_panel <- function(qual) {
  (quality_silhouette_plot(qual, "mRNA", ylab = "mRNA\nmodules") | quality_connectivity_plot(qual, "mRNA")) /
    (quality_silhouette_plot(qual, "protein", ylab = "Protein\nmodules") | quality_connectivity_plot(qual, "protein")) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

bcell <- get_unit("B cells"); bcell_mod <- identify_modules(bcell$prot, bcell$rna, P$ds_within); stopifnot(!is.null(bcell_mod))
bcell_prot_lab <- module_labels(bcell_mod$prot_clusters, bcell_mod$union_genes)
bcell_rna_lab  <- module_labels(bcell_mod$rna_clusters,  bcell_mod$union_genes)
bcell_qual     <- module_quality(bcell_mod, bcell_prot_lab, bcell_rna_lab)
ord_prot <- heatmap_module_order(bcell_mod$prot_clusters); ord_rna <- heatmap_module_order(bcell_mod$rna_clusters)

p_bcell_heatmap_prot <- triangle_heatmap(bcell_mod$prot_cor, bcell_mod$rna_cor, bcell_mod$prot_clusters, "B cells",
                                         legend_direction = "vertical", legend_position = "right")
rna_order <- unlist(lapply(sort(unique(bcell_mod$rna_clusters)), function(m) {
  genes <- names(bcell_mod$rna_clusters)[bcell_mod$rna_clusters == m]; if (length(genes) <= 2) return(genes)
  genes[hclust(as.dist(1 - bcell_mod$rna_cor[genes, genes]), method = "ward.D2")$order] }))
p_bcell_heatmap_rna <- triangle_heatmap(bcell_mod$prot_cor, bcell_mod$rna_cor, bcell_mod$rna_clusters, "B cells", gene_order = rna_order)
p_bcell_box_prot <- within_box(bcell_mod$prot_clusters, bcell_mod$prot_cor, bcell_mod$rna_cor, bcell_prot_lab, ord_prot, legend_position = "none")
p_bcell_box_rna  <- within_box(bcell_mod$rna_clusters, bcell_mod$prot_cor, bcell_mod$rna_cor, bcell_rna_lab, ord_rna)

panel_bcell_protein <- assemble_panel(p_bcell_heatmap_prot, p_bcell_box_prot, bcell_prot_lab, ord_prot)  # MF2 G
panel_bcell_rna     <- assemble_panel(p_bcell_heatmap_rna,  p_bcell_box_rna,  bcell_rna_lab,  ord_rna)    # SF4B A
panel_bcell_quality <- quality_panel(bcell_qual)                                                          # SF4B B
cat(sprintf("  B cells: %d protein / %d mRNA modules\n",
            length(unique(bcell_mod$prot_clusters)), length(unique(bcell_mod$rna_clusters))))

## M7c — CROSS-DONOR VALIDATION OF B-CELL MODULES

cat("\n=== M7c — cross-donor validation of B-cell protein modules ===\n")
set.seed(42)   # LOCAL

m7c_params <- list(
  min_coobs        = 100,    
  det_within_donor = P$det,  
  deep_split       = P$ds_within,
  min_cluster_size = P$mcs,
  n_perm           = 1000,   
  min_pairs        = 20,     
  scatter_module   = "2"     
)


# ── M7c.0  Donor assignment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
m7c_donor_of <- setNames(
  dplyr::recode(as.character(pbmc.prot@meta.data$sample),
                "Donor04" = "Donor 1", "Donor05" = "Donor 2"),
  rownames(pbmc.prot@meta.data))

m7c_universe    <- bcell_mod$union_genes
m7c_bcell_cells <- bcell$prot_cells
m7c_donor_vec   <- m7c_donor_of[m7c_bcell_cells]
if (anyNA(m7c_donor_vec))
  stop(sprintf("[M7c] %d of %d B-cell protein cells lack a donor assignment.",
               sum(is.na(m7c_donor_vec)), length(m7c_bcell_cells)))
if (any(!m7c_donor_vec %in% c("Donor 1", "Donor 2")))
  stop("[M7c] Unexpected donor label after recode.")

m7c_donors <- c("Donor 1", "Donor 2")   # fixed order; matches donor_colors
d1 <- m7c_donors[1]; d2 <- m7c_donors[2]
m7c_cells_by_donor <- lapply(m7c_donors, function(d) m7c_bcell_cells[m7c_donor_vec == d])
names(m7c_cells_by_donor) <- m7c_donors

stopifnot(all(m7c_donors %in% names(donor_colors)))

cat(sprintf("  Universe inherited from M7: %d gene-products\n", length(m7c_universe)))
cat("  B cells per donor:\n"); print(table(m7c_donor_vec))


########################################################################################
## PART 1 — INDEPENDENT PER-DONOR MODULE IDENTIFICATION
########################################################################################

# ── M7c.1  Per-donor detection filter ────────────────────────────────────────────────

m7c_detect_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(m7c_donors, function(d) {
  m <- sc.batch_cor[m7c_universe, m7c_cells_by_donor[[d]], drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(donor = d, gene = m7c_universe, det_frac = rowMeans(!is.na(m)),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
m7c_pass_by_donor <- lapply(m7c_donors, function(d)
  m7c_detect_tbl$gene[m7c_detect_tbl$donor == d &
                        m7c_detect_tbl$det_frac >= m7c_params$det_within_donor])
names(m7c_pass_by_donor) <- m7c_donors
m7c_genes <- Reduce(intersect, m7c_pass_by_donor)

cat(sprintf("\n  [1] Universe retained in both donors: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            length(m7c_genes), length(m7c_universe),
            100 * length(m7c_genes) / length(m7c_universe)))
if (length(m7c_genes) < m7c_params$min_cluster_size * 2)
  stop("[M7c] Too few gene-products survive the per-donor detection filter.")


# ── M7c.2  Independent clustering within each donor ──────────────────────────────────
m7c_clusters_by_donor <- lapply(m7c_donors, function(d)
  cut_modules(pearson_cor(sc.batch_cor[m7c_genes, m7c_cells_by_donor[[d]], drop = FALSE]),
              deep_split = m7c_params$deep_split, mcs = m7c_params$min_cluster_size))
names(m7c_clusters_by_donor) <- m7c_donors

for (d in m7c_donors)
  cat(sprintf("      %s: %d modules | sizes: %s\n", d,
              length(unique(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d]])),
              paste(as.integer(table(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d]])), collapse = ", ")))


# ── M7c.3  Adjusted Rand Index + label-permutation null ──────────────────────────────
m7c_adjusted_rand <- function(a, b) {
  tab <- table(a, b); n <- sum(tab)
  if (n < 2) return(NA_real_)
  choose2  <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2
  sum_ij   <- sum(choose2(as.vector(tab)))
  sum_i    <- sum(choose2(rowSums(tab)))
  sum_j    <- sum(choose2(colSums(tab)))
  expected <- sum_i * sum_j / choose2(n)
  maximum  <- (sum_i + sum_j) / 2
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(maximum, expected))) return(NA_real_)
  (sum_ij - expected) / (maximum - expected)
}

m7c_both <- intersect(names(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d1]]), names(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d2]]))
m7c_lab1 <- m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d1]][m7c_both]
m7c_lab2 <- m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d2]][m7c_both]

m7c_ari      <- m7c_adjusted_rand(m7c_lab1, m7c_lab2)
m7c_ari_null <- replicate(m7c_params$n_perm, m7c_adjusted_rand(m7c_lab1, sample(m7c_lab2)))
m7c_ari_p    <- (sum(m7c_ari_null >= m7c_ari, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
  (sum(is.finite(m7c_ari_null)) + 1)
m7c_ari_p_txt <- ifelse(m7c_ari_p < 1 / m7c_params$n_perm,
                        sprintf("< %.0e", 1 / m7c_params$n_perm),
                        sprintf("%.3g", m7c_ari_p))

cat(sprintf("\n      Gene-products clustered in both donors : %d\n", length(m7c_both)))
cat(sprintf("      Adjusted Rand Index                    : %.3f\n", m7c_ari))
cat(sprintf("      Permutation null, mean (SD)            : %.3f (%.3f)\n",
            mean(m7c_ari_null, na.rm = TRUE), sd(m7c_ari_null, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("      Permutation p                          : %s\n", m7c_ari_p_txt))
cat(sprintf("\n      >> FOR TEXT: ARI = %.2f, permutation p %s\n", m7c_ari, m7c_ari_p_txt))


# ── M7c.4b  DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — per-module Jaccard best match ──────────────────────────

local({
  s1 <- clusters_to_sets(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d1]])
  s2 <- clusters_to_sets(m7c_clusters_by_donor[[d2]])
  jac <- expand.grid(mod1 = names(s1), mod2 = names(s2),
                     KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_shared = mapply(function(a, b) length(intersect(s1[[a]], s2[[b]])), mod1, mod2),
      jaccard  = mapply(function(a, b)
        length(intersect(s1[[a]], s2[[b]])) / length(union(s1[[a]], s2[[b]])), mod1, mod2))
  best <- jac %>% dplyr::group_by(mod1) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(jaccard, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(size_d1 = vapply(mod1, function(m) length(s1[[m]]), integer(1)),
                  size_d2 = vapply(mod2, function(m) length(s2[[m]]), integer(1))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(size_d1))
  cat("\n      [diagnostic, not for manuscript] Best match per donor-1 module:\n")
  print(best %>% dplyr::transmute(donor1 = paste0("M", mod1), size_d1,
                                  best_donor2 = paste0("M", mod2), size_d2,
                                  n_shared, jaccard = round(jaccard, 3)) %>%
          as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
  m7c_jaccard_diag <<- best
})


########################################################################################
## PART 2 — WITHIN-MODULE CORRELATION MAGNITUDE BY DONOR  (PANEL, LEFT)
########################################################################################

m7c_within_by_donor <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(m7c_donors, function(d) {
  cells <- m7c_cells_by_donor[[d]]
  purrr::imap_dfr(clusters_to_sets(bcell_mod$prot_clusters), function(g, mid) {
    g <- intersect(g, rownames(sc.batch_cor))
    if (length(g) < 2) return(NULL)
    sub  <- sc.batch_cor[g, cells, drop = FALSE]
    r    <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(sub), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    ob   <- !is.na(sub); storage.mode(ob) <- "integer"
    nmat <- tcrossprod(ob)
    vals <- r[lower.tri(r) & nmat >= m7c_params$min_coobs]
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
    if (!length(vals)) return(NULL)
    tibble::tibble(donor = d, module = mid, r = vals)
  })
}))

# Module labels and ordering taken directly from panel G/H.
m7c_box_lab <- bcell_prot_lab %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lab = ifelse(is.na(term), paste0("M", module), paste0("M", module, ": ", term)))
m7c_lvl <- m7c_box_lab$lab[match(ord_prot, m7c_box_lab$module)]

m7c_within_by_donor <- m7c_within_by_donor %>%
  dplyr::left_join(m7c_box_lab %>% dplyr::select(module, lab), by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lab   = factor(lab, levels = rev(m7c_lvl)),
                donor = factor(donor, levels = m7c_donors))

cat("\n  [2] Within-module protein correlation by donor (pooled module definitions)\n")
print(m7c_within_by_donor %>% dplyr::group_by(module, donor) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n_pairs = dplyr::n(), median_r = round(median(r, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                         .groups = "drop") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = c(n_pairs, median_r)) %>%
        as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)



########################################################################################
## PART 3 — WIRING PRESERVATION  (RANGE IN TEXT; ONE SCATTER, PANEL RIGHT)
########################################################################################

m7c_genes_H <- names(bcell_mod$prot_clusters)
m7c_sets_H  <- clusters_to_sets(bcell_mod$prot_clusters)
m7c_mods_H  <- as.character(sort(as.integer(names(m7c_sets_H))))

m7c_cor_masked <- function(cells) {
  sub  <- sc.batch_cor[m7c_genes_H, cells, drop = FALSE]
  r    <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(sub), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  ob   <- !is.na(sub); storage.mode(ob) <- "integer"
  r[tcrossprod(ob) < m7c_params$min_coobs] <- NA_real_
  diag(r) <- 1
  r
}
m7c_cor_H <- lapply(m7c_cells_by_donor, m7c_cor_masked)
names(m7c_cor_H) <- m7c_donors

m7c_wiring_one <- function(mi) {
  g  <- m7c_sets_H[[mi]]
  A  <- m7c_cor_H[[d1]][g, g]; B <- m7c_cor_H[[d2]][g, g]
  ut <- upper.tri(A)
  va <- A[ut]; vb <- B[ut]
  ok <- is.finite(va) & is.finite(vb)
  if (sum(ok) < m7c_params$min_pairs)
    return(data.frame(module = mi, n_pairs = sum(ok), r = NA_real_, perm_p = NA_real_))
  obs  <- cor(va[ok], vb[ok])
  null <- replicate(m7c_params$n_perm, {
    p <- sample(seq_along(g)); vp <- B[p, p][ut]
    o <- is.finite(va) & is.finite(vp)
    if (sum(o) < m7c_params$min_pairs) return(NA_real_)
    cor(va[o], vp[o])
  })
  data.frame(module = mi, n_pairs = sum(ok), r = obs,
             perm_p = (sum(null >= obs, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (sum(is.finite(null)) + 1))
}

m7c_wiring <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(m7c_mods_H, m7c_wiring_one)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(size = vapply(module, function(m) length(m7c_sets_H[[m]]), integer(1)),
                perm_fdr = p.adjust(perm_p, method = "BH"))

cat("\n  [3] Within-module wiring preservation across donors\n")
print(m7c_wiring %>%
        dplyr::transmute(module = paste0("M", module), size, n_pairs,
                         r = round(r, 3), perm_p = signif(perm_p, 3),
                         perm_fdr = signif(perm_fdr, 3)) %>%
        as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n      >> FOR TEXT: wiring r = %.2f-%.2f (median %.2f), all permutation p <= %.3g\n",
            min(m7c_wiring$r, na.rm = TRUE), max(m7c_wiring$r, na.rm = TRUE),
            median(m7c_wiring$r, na.rm = TRUE), max(m7c_wiring$perm_p, na.rm = TRUE)))


# ── Representative scatter: one module, every usable gene pair ───────────────────────
m7c_scat_mod  <- m7c_params$scatter_module
m7c_scat_stat <- m7c_wiring %>% dplyr::filter(module == m7c_scat_mod)
m7c_scat_term <- bcell_prot_lab$term[match(m7c_scat_mod, bcell_prot_lab$module)]
m7c_scat_title <- ifelse(is.na(m7c_scat_term), paste0("M", m7c_scat_mod),
                         paste0("M", m7c_scat_mod, ": ", m7c_scat_term))

split_two_lines <- function(s) {
  w <- strsplit(s, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(w) < 2) return(s)
  cum  <- cumsum(nchar(w) + 1) - 1
  brk  <- which.min(abs(cum - nchar(s) / 2))
  brk  <- min(max(brk, 1L), length(w) - 1L)   # never an empty line
  paste(paste(w[seq_len(brk)], collapse = " "),
        paste(w[(brk + 1):length(w)], collapse = " "), sep = "\n")
}
m7c_scat_title_wrapped <- split_two_lines(m7c_scat_title)

m7c_scatter_df <- local({
  g  <- m7c_sets_H[[m7c_scat_mod]]
  A  <- m7c_cor_H[[d1]][g, g]; B <- m7c_cor_H[[d2]][g, g]
  ut <- upper.tri(A)
  df <- data.frame(d1 = A[ut], d2 = B[ut])
  df <- df[is.finite(df$d1) & is.finite(df$d2), , drop = FALSE]
  df$panel_lab <- m7c_scat_title_wrapped
  df
})
m7c_scat_lim <- range(c(m7c_scatter_df$d1, m7c_scatter_df$d2), na.rm = TRUE)

p_m7c_wiring_scatter <- ggplot(m7c_scatter_df, aes(x = d1, y = d2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +

  geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.30, colour = "black") +
annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf,
         label = sprintf("r = %.2f", m7c_scat_stat$r),
         hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.0, fontface = "bold") +
annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf,
         label = sprintf("n = %s protein pairs",
                         format(m7c_scat_stat$n_pairs, big.mark = ",")),
         hjust = 0, vjust = 3.0, size = 2.0, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel_lab) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = m7c_scat_lim, ylim = m7c_scat_lim) +
  labs(x = sprintf("%s, B cells\nprotein-protein correlations", d1),
       y = sprintf("%s, B cells\nprotein-protein correlations", d2)) +
  theme_light(base_size = 5.5) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 6.5, lineheight = 1.0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


########################################################################################
## PANEL A — split violins (Part 2 data) annotated with wiring r (Part 3 values)
########################################################################################

m7c_r_annot <- m7c_wiring %>%
  dplyr::select(module, r) %>%

                label = sprintf("r = %.2f", r))

m7c_violin_ylim <- c(min(m7c_within_by_donor$r, na.rm = TRUE), 1.05)

p_m7c_within_violin <- ggplot(m7c_within_by_donor, aes(x = lab, y = r, fill = donor)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "B cells\nWithin-module Pearson r") +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "center",
        legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
```

```{r, Script 7}

########################################################################################
## SCRIPT 7 / 8 :
##
## Assumes Script 1 (setup): sc.batch_cor(.ab), pbmc.so, pbmc.prot,
## cell_types_df, celltype_colors, GeomSplitViolin/geom_split_violin, save_figure,
## figure_theme (8 pt), FIG_WIDTH_MM, results_dir.
##
## Required for this figure: fgsea, msigdbr, ggh4x, dynamicTreeCut, plyr (hard deps).
########################################################################################

# ── Guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local({
  need <- c("sc.batch_cor", "sc.batch_cor.ab", "pbmc.so", "pbmc.prot", "cell_types_df",
            "celltype_colors", "GeomSplitViolin", "geom_split_violin",
            "save_figure", "figure_theme", "FIG_WIDTH_MM", "results_dir")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(miss))
    stop(sprintf("[MF3] Missing (run Script 1 setup first): %s", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
})

suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("dynamicTreeCut", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("fgsea",          quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("msigdbr",        quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("scales",         quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("SeuratObject",   quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("ggh4x",          quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("plyr",           quietly = TRUE))
})
set.seed(42)   

ct_x <- "Monocytes"; ct_y <- "CD8 T cells"

# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
min_frac <- 1; min_pairs <- 20; inner_cor_method <- "pearson"
mod_min_size <- 5; mod_deepsplit <- 3; mod_min_median_r <- 0.2
left_hi <- 0.1; right_lo <- 0.4
n_clusters_per_set <- 2
n_null_iter <- 1000
enrich_fdr <- 0.01; fora_min_size <- 3; fora_max_size <- 300; n_top_terms <- 1
cor_limits <- c(-0.4, 0.4); cor_gradient <- c(low = "darkblue", mid = "white", high = "#CE2029")
cor_breaks <- c(cor_limits[1], 0, cor_limits[2])
cor_labels <- c(sprintf("\u2264 %g", cor_limits[1]), "0", sprintf("\u2265 %g", cor_limits[2]))

module_colors <- c("L1" = "#7CC678", "L2" = "#388E3C", "R1" = "#FF8FB1", "R2" = "#E75480")
mf3_split_colors <- celltype_colors[c(ct_x, ct_y)]   
celltype_strip_fill <- "grey60"
ap_violin_fill <- "grey85"; ap_violin_border <- "grey40"

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "exploratory")

cell_types_df <- dplyr::filter(cell_types_df, CellType != "Dendritic cells")


# ══ Helpers ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
get_celltype_matrix <- function(celltype, sc_matrix, ct_df, min_frac = 0.70) {
  cells <- intersect(ct_df$Cell[ct_df$CellType == celltype], colnames(sc_matrix))
  m <- sc_matrix[, cells, drop = FALSE]; m[rowMeans(!is.na(m)) >= min_frac, , drop = FALSE]
}
module_filter <- function(cor_orig, min_size = 10, deepsplit = 3, min_median_r = 0.20) {
  if (is.null(cor_orig) || is.null(rownames(cor_orig)) || nrow(cor_orig) < min_size) return(character(0))
  prot <- rownames(cor_orig); cf <- cor_orig; cf[!is.finite(cf)] <- 0; d <- 1 - cf; diag(d) <- 0
  hc <- hclust(as.dist(d), method = "ward.D2")
  mods <- dynamicTreeCut::cutreeDynamic(dendro = hc, distM = d, method = "hybrid",
                                        deepSplit = deepsplit, minClusterSize = min_size, verbose = 0)
  names(mods) <- prot; keep <- character(0)
  for (mm in setdiff(unique(mods), 0)) {
    pm <- names(mods)[mods == mm]; sub <- cor_orig[pm, pm, drop = FALSE]; vals <- sub[upper.tri(sub)]
    if (length(vals) && median(vals, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_median_r) keep <- c(keep, pm)
  }
  keep
}
cross_set_cor <- function(m, left, right, method = "pearson")
  suppressWarnings(cor(t(m[left, , drop = FALSE]), t(m[right, , drop = FALSE]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method))
hclust_profiles <- function(mat, margin) {
  x <- if (margin == 1) t(mat) else mat
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")); cmat[!is.finite(cmat)] <- 0
  hclust(as.dist(1 - cmat), method = "ward.D2")
}
relabel_clusters <- function(cl_int, ordered_items, prefix) {
  appearance <- cl_int[ordered_items]; lvl <- unique(appearance); setNames(paste0(prefix, match(cl_int, lvl)), names(cl_int))
}
vec_cor_pass <- function(mx, my, method, min_pairs) {
  cx <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(mx), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method))
  cy <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(my), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method))
  diag(cx) <- NA; diag(cy) <- NA
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(mx)), function(i) {
    va <- cx[, i]; vb <- cy[, i]; ok <- is.finite(va) & is.finite(vb)
    if (sum(ok) < min_pairs) return(NA_real_)
    if (sd(va[ok]) == 0 || sd(vb[ok]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    suppressWarnings(cor(va[ok], vb[ok], method = method))
  }, numeric(1))
}
permute_matrix <- function(m) { obs <- which(!is.na(m)); m[obs] <- sample(m[obs]); m }

get_go_gene_sets <- function() {
  df <- tryCatch(msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0)
    df <- tryCatch(msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP"), error = function(e) NULL)
  stopifnot(!is.null(df), nrow(df) > 0)
  gene_col <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% names(df)) "gene_symbol" else "human_gene_symbol"
  split(df[[gene_col]], df$gs_name)
}
run_fora_cluster <- function(genes, universe, pathways, fdr = 0.01, min_size = 3, max_size = 500) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, universe); if (length(genes) < 2) return(data.frame())
  res <- as.data.frame(fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways, genes = genes, universe = universe, minSize = min_size, maxSize = max_size))
  if (nrow(res) == 0) return(res)
  res$gene_ratio <- res$overlap / length(genes)
  res <- res[is.finite(res$padj) & res$padj < fdr, , drop = FALSE]
  res[order(-res$gene_ratio, res$padj), , drop = FALSE]
}
prettify_term <- function(x) { x <- sub("^GOBP_", "", x); x <- gsub("_", " ", x); tools::toTitleCase(tolower(x)) }
make_strip_label <- function(cluster_id, res, n = 2, wrap = 24) {
  terms <- if (nrow(res) == 0) character(0) else prettify_term(utils::head(res$pathway, n))
  if (length(terms) == 0) terms <- "no GO:BP term (FDR<1%)"
  terms <- vapply(terms, function(t) paste(strwrap(t, width = wrap), collapse = "\n"), character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  paste0(cluster_id, "\n", paste(terms, collapse = "\n"))
}
block_mean_corr <- function(cross_mat, left_mod, right_mod) {
  blk <- cross_mat[left_mod, right_mod, drop = FALSE]
  c(setNames(rowMeans(blk, na.rm = TRUE), left_mod), setNames(colMeans(blk, na.rm = TRUE), right_mod))
}
abundance_log2fc <- function(genes) {  
  out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(genes)), genes); g <- intersect(genes, rownames(sc.batch_cor.ab))
  if (length(g)) out[g] <- vapply(g, function(x) mean(sc.batch_cor.ab[x, cells_x], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(sc.batch_cor.ab[x, cells_y], na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  out
}
cor_annot <- function(x, y, prefix = "") {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); if (sum(ok) < 3L) return(sprintf("%sn = %d (too few for r)", prefix, sum(ok)))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")); p <- ct$p.value
  pstr <- if (is.finite(p) && p < 2.2e-16) "p < 2.2e-16" else sprintf("p = %.2g", p)
  sprintf("%sr = %.2f (%s, n = %d)", prefix, unname(ct$estimate), pstr, sum(ok))
}
build_tail_heatmap <- function(prot_set, title_label, strip_fill, strip_border,
                               mat = sc.batch_cor, cells_a = cells_x, cells_b = cells_y, title_size = 5) {
  prot_set <- intersect(prot_set, rownames(mat))
  cm_mono <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(mat[prot_set, cells_a, drop = FALSE]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = inner_cor_method))
  cm_cd8  <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(mat[prot_set, cells_b, drop = FALSE]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = inner_cor_method))
  cf <- cm_mono; cf[!is.finite(cf)] <- 0; po <- rownames(cm_mono)[hclust(as.dist(1 - cf), method = "ward.D2")$order]
  cm_mono <- cm_mono[po, po]; cm_cd8 <- cm_cd8[po, po]; n <- length(po)
  comb <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(po, po)); lt <- lower.tri(comb); ut <- upper.tri(comb)
  comb[lt] <- cm_mono[lt]; comb[ut] <- cm_cd8[ut]
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(comb), stringsAsFactors = FALSE); names(df) <- c("prot_row", "prot_col", "r")
  df$prot_row <- factor(df$prot_row, levels = po); df$prot_col <- factor(df$prot_col, levels = po); df$panel_title <- title_label
  show_axis <- n <= 60
  ggplot(df, aes(prot_col, prot_row, fill = r)) + geom_tile() + facet_wrap(~ panel_title) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = po, position = "bottom") + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(po), position = "right") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = cor_gradient[["low"]], mid = cor_gradient[["mid"]], high = cor_gradient[["high"]], midpoint = 0,
                         limits = cor_limits, breaks = cor_breaks, labels = cor_labels, oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey85", name = "Pearson r") +
    labs(x = ct_x, y = ct_y) + coord_equal() + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = strip_fill, colour = strip_border, linewidth = 0.9),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold", size = title_size),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic"), axis.title.y.right = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic"),
          axis.text.x = if (show_axis) element_text(size = 5, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5) else element_blank(),
          axis.text.y.right = if (show_axis) element_text(size = 5) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = if (show_axis) element_line(linewidth = 0.2) else element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
}


# ══ 1. Selection: 100% filter -> within-CT cor -> module enrichment -> union ═══════════
m_X <- get_celltype_matrix(ct_x, sc.batch_cor, cell_types_df, min_frac)
m_Y <- get_celltype_matrix(ct_y, sc.batch_cor, cell_types_df, min_frac)
cor_x0 <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(m_X), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = inner_cor_method))
cor_y0 <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(m_Y), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = inner_cor_method))
surv_x <- module_filter(cor_x0, mod_min_size, mod_deepsplit, mod_min_median_r)
surv_y <- module_filter(cor_y0, mod_min_size, mod_deepsplit, mod_min_median_r)
union_set <- union(surv_x, surv_y)
cat(sprintf("%s: %d cells, %d prot, %d survivors | %s: %d cells, %d prot, %d survivors | union: %d\n",
            ct_x, ncol(m_X), nrow(m_X), length(surv_x), ct_y, ncol(m_Y), nrow(m_Y), length(surv_y), length(union_set)))
stopifnot(length(union_set) >= 3)

# ══ 2. vec_cor over union ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cells_x <- intersect(cell_types_df$Cell[cell_types_df$CellType == ct_x], colnames(sc.batch_cor))
cells_y <- intersect(cell_types_df$Cell[cell_types_df$CellType == ct_y], colnames(sc.batch_cor))
mx_u <- sc.batch_cor[union_set, cells_x, drop = FALSE]; my_u <- sc.batch_cor[union_set, cells_y, drop = FALSE]
vec_cor <- vec_cor_pass(mx_u, my_u, inner_cor_method, min_pairs); names(vec_cor) <- union_set
analysis_universe <- names(vec_cor)[is.finite(vec_cor)]

# ══ 2b. Null distribution (Panel A) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
null_vals <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(n_null_iter), function(it)
  vec_cor_pass(permute_matrix(mx_u), permute_matrix(my_u), inner_cor_method, min_pairs)))
null_vals <- null_vals[is.finite(null_vals)]
cat(sprintf("null: n=%d (median %.3f) across %d iters\n", length(null_vals), median(null_vals), n_null_iter))

# ══ 3. Tails ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
dist_finite <- vec_cor[is.finite(vec_cor)]
left_lo <- min(dist_finite); right_hi <- max(dist_finite)
a_pad <- 0.02 * (right_hi - left_lo); a_xlim <- c(left_lo - a_pad, right_hi + a_pad)
left_set  <- names(which(vec_cor >= left_lo & vec_cor <= left_hi))
right_set <- names(which(vec_cor > right_lo))
cat(sprintf("scored: %d | left tail: %d | right tail: %d\n", length(dist_finite), length(left_set), length(right_set)))
stopifnot(length(left_set) >= 2, length(right_set) >= 2)

# ══ 4. Cross-set correlations ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cross_X <- cross_set_cor(mx_u, left_set, right_set, inner_cor_method)   # Monocytes (reference)
cross_Y <- cross_set_cor(my_u, left_set, right_set, inner_cor_method)   # CD8 T cells

# ══ 5. FIXED k=2 clustering per tail (Ward.D2 on 1 - r of Monocyte cross-set) ═════════
hc_left  <- hclust_profiles(cross_X, margin = 1)
hc_right <- hclust_profiles(cross_X, margin = 2)
left_ordered  <- hc_left$labels[hc_left$order]; right_ordered <- hc_right$labels[hc_right$order]
left_cluster  <- relabel_clusters(cutree(hc_left,  k = n_clusters_per_set), left_ordered,  "L")
right_cluster <- relabel_clusters(cutree(hc_right, k = n_clusters_per_set), right_ordered, "R")

# ══ 6. GO:BP over-representation per cluster (universe = analysis_universe) ════════════
go_sets <- get_go_gene_sets()
left_genes_by_cluster  <- split(names(left_cluster),  left_cluster)
right_genes_by_cluster <- split(names(right_cluster), right_cluster)
fora_left  <- lapply(left_genes_by_cluster,  run_fora_cluster, universe = analysis_universe, pathways = go_sets, fdr = enrich_fdr, min_size = fora_min_size, max_size = fora_max_size)
fora_right <- lapply(right_genes_by_cluster, run_fora_cluster, universe = analysis_universe, pathways = go_sets, fdr = enrich_fdr, min_size = fora_min_size, max_size = fora_max_size)
collect_enrichment <- function(fora_list, set_label) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(fora_list), function(cl) {
    res <- fora_list[[cl]]; if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(set = set_label, cluster = cl, pathway = res$pathway, pathway_pretty = prettify_term(res$pathway),
               padj = res$padj, overlap = res$overlap, size = res$size, gene_ratio = res$gene_ratio,
               overlap_genes = vapply(res$overlapGenes, paste, character(1), collapse = ";"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
enrichment_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(collect_enrichment(fora_left, "left_tail"), collect_enrichment(fora_right, "right_tail"))
left_strip_labels  <- vapply(names(fora_left),  function(cl) make_strip_label(cl, fora_left[[cl]],  n = n_top_terms), character(1))
right_strip_labels <- vapply(names(fora_right), function(cl) make_strip_label(cl, fora_right[[cl]], n = n_top_terms), character(1))
right_strip_labels <- gsub("Response to Bacterium", "Response to\nBacterium", right_strip_labels, fixed = TRUE)
left_strip_labels  <- gsub("Response to Bacterium", "Response to\nBacterium", left_strip_labels, fixed = TRUE)
left_strip_labels  <- gsub("Protein Maturation", "Protein\nMaturation", left_strip_labels, fixed = TRUE)

# ══ 7. Per-protein / per-block metrics ════════════════════════════════════════════════
L1_set <- names(left_cluster)[left_cluster == "L1"]; L2_set <- names(left_cluster)[left_cluster == "L2"]
R1_set <- names(right_cluster)[right_cluster == "R1"]; R2_set <- names(right_cluster)[right_cluster == "R2"]
mod_members <- list(L1 = L1_set, L2 = L2_set, R1 = R1_set, R2 = R2_set)
block_defs <- list("L1-R1" = c("L1","R1"), "L1-R2" = c("L1","R2"), "L2-R1" = c("L2","R1"), "L2-R2" = c("L2","R2"))
block_levels <- names(block_defs)

build_block_protein_df <- function() {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(block_levels, function(bn) {
    lmod <- block_defs[[bn]][1]; rmod <- block_defs[[bn]][2]; lm <- mod_members[[lmod]]; rm_ <- mod_members[[rmod]]
    members <- c(lm, rm_)
    mc_mono <- block_mean_corr(cross_X, lm, rm_)[members]; mc_cd8 <- block_mean_corr(cross_Y, lm, rm_)[members]; fc <- abundance_log2fc(members)[members]
    data.frame(block = bn, gene = members, module = ifelse(members %in% lm, lmod, rmod),
               mean_corr_mono = unname(mc_mono), mean_corr_cd8 = unname(mc_cd8),
               corr_diff = unname(mc_mono - mc_cd8), log2fc = unname(fc), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
block_protein_df <- build_block_protein_df() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(block = factor(block, levels = block_levels), module = factor(module, levels = c("L1","L2","R1","R2")))

rewire_df <- block_protein_df %>% dplyr::filter(block == "L2-R2", is.finite(log2fc), is.finite(corr_diff))
rewire_df$module <- factor(as.character(rewire_df$module), levels = c("L2", "R2")); rewire_df$panel_block <- "L2\u2013R2"

build_block_paircorr_df <- function() {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(block_levels, function(bn) {
    lmod <- block_defs[[bn]][1]; rmod <- block_defs[[bn]][2]; lm <- mod_members[[lmod]]; rm_ <- mod_members[[rmod]]
    blk_mono <- cross_X[lm, rm_, drop = FALSE]; blk_cd8 <- cross_Y[lm, rm_, drop = FALSE]
    dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(block = bn, celltype = ct_x, r = as.vector(blk_mono), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                     data.frame(block = bn, celltype = ct_y, r = as.vector(blk_cd8), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }))
}
blockcorr_long <- build_block_paircorr_df() %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(r)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(block = factor(block, levels = block_levels), celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c(ct_x, ct_y)))
fc_box_df <- block_protein_df %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2fc))
summary_pts <- block_protein_df %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2fc), is.finite(corr_diff))
centroid_df <- summary_pts %>% dplyr::group_by(block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(x = mean(log2fc), y = mean(corr_diff), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(block = factor(block, levels = block_levels))


# ══ PANEL A sub-plots ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
A_all_hm   <- build_tail_heatmap(analysis_universe, "All protein correlations", strip_fill = celltype_strip_fill, strip_border = celltype_strip_fill)
A_right_hm <- build_tail_heatmap(right_set, "Right-tail protein correlations", strip_fill = module_colors[["R1"]], strip_border = module_colors[["R2"]])

n_prot <- length(dist_finite)
vec_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(dist = "All proteins", value = dist_finite, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                           data.frame(dist = "Null", value = null_vals, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
vec_df$dist <- factor(vec_df$dist, levels = c("All proteins", "Null"))
A_dist <- ggplot(vec_df, aes(x = dist, y = value)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.74, xmax = 1.26, ymin = left_lo, ymax = left_hi, fill = module_colors[["L1"]], alpha = 0.28, colour = module_colors[["L2"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.74, xmax = 1.26, ymin = right_lo, ymax = right_hi, fill = module_colors[["R1"]], alpha = 0.28, colour = module_colors[["R2"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_violin(fill = ap_violin_fill, colour = ap_violin_border, linewidth = 0.3, scale = "width", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.45) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = sprintf("Correlations of protein correlation vectors, n = %d", n_prot)) +
  coord_flip(ylim = a_xlim) + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, angle = 0, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))


# ══ PANEL B — annotated cross-set heatmap ═════════════════════════════════════════════
melt_cross <- function(mat, celltype) {
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE); names(df) <- c("left_protein", "right_protein", "r"); df$celltype <- celltype; df
}
cross_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(melt_cross(cross_X, ct_x), melt_cross(cross_Y, ct_y)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(left_protein = factor(left_protein, levels = left_ordered), right_protein = factor(right_protein, levels = right_ordered),
                celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c(ct_x, ct_y)),
                left_cluster = factor(left_cluster[as.character(left_protein)], levels = names(left_strip_labels)),
                right_cluster = factor(right_cluster[as.character(right_protein)], levels = names(right_strip_labels)))
MF3_B <- ggplot(cross_df, aes(right_protein, left_protein, fill = r)) + geom_tile() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(rows = vars(left_cluster), cols = vars(celltype, right_cluster), scales = "free", space = "free",
    labeller = labeller(left_cluster = left_strip_labels, right_cluster = right_strip_labels, celltype = ggplot2::label_value),
    strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(
      background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = c(celltype_strip_fill, celltype_strip_fill, module_colors[["R1"]], module_colors[["R2"]], module_colors[["R1"]], module_colors[["R2"]])),
      text_x = ggh4x::elem_list_text(size = c(6.6, 6.6, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5), colour = "white", face = "bold", lineheight = 0.9),
      background_y = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = c(module_colors[["L1"]], module_colors[["L2"]])))) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = cor_gradient[["low"]], mid = cor_gradient[["mid"]], high = cor_gradient[["high"]], midpoint = 0,
                       limits = cor_limits, breaks = cor_breaks, labels = cor_labels, oob = scales::squish, name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = "Right-tail proteins", y = "Left-tail proteins") + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold", size = 5.5, lineheight = 0.9),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))


# ══ PANEL D — L2-R2 rewiring vs abundance FC ══════════════════════════════════════════
MF3_D <- ggplot(rewire_df, aes(log2fc, corr_diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "black", colour = "black", stroke = 0.3, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel_block) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.2, label = cor_annot(rewire_df$log2fc, rewire_df$corr_diff)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.45, 0.25)) +
  labs(x = expression("log"[2]*" abundance FC (Monocytes \u2212 CD8 T cells)"),
       y = expression(atop(Delta*" mean within-block r", "(Monocytes \u2212 CD8 T cells)"))) +
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = celltype_strip_fill), strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold", size = 7),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))


# ══ PANEL C (top) — RAW within-block pairwise corr distributions ══════════════════════
MF3_C_corr <- ggplot(blockcorr_long, aes(x = block, y = r, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_split_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey25", alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mf3_split_colors, name = "Cell type") +

# ══ PANEL C (bottom) — per-block log2 abundance FC; points BLACK ══════════════════════
MF3_C_fc <- ggplot(fc_box_df, aes(block, log2fc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.3) +

MF3_E <- ggplot() +

# ══ Assemble MF3 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n=== Assembling MF3 ===\n")
MF3_A <- wrap_elements(full = (A_all_hm | A_dist | A_right_hm) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1), guides = "collect"))
MF3_C_stack <- (MF3_C_corr / MF3_C_fc) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())
MF3_C <- wrap_elements(full = MF3_C_stack)
MF3_DE <- (MF3_D / MF3_E) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
MF3_block <- (MF3_C | MF3_DE) + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))

MF3 <- (MF3_A / MF3_B / MF3_block) + plot_layout(heights = c(1.20, 1.10, 1.70)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
MF3 <- MF3 & figure_theme
MF3_HEIGHT_MM <- 200
save_figure(MF3, "Fig3", width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM, height_mm = MF3_HEIGHT_MM)


# ══ SF5 — mRNA counterpart ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
get_data_matrix <- function(obj) {
  m <- tryCatch(as.matrix(SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj, slot = "data")), error = function(e)
    tryCatch(as.matrix(SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")), error = function(e2) NULL))
  if (is.null(m) || !nrow(m)) stop("Could not extract an mRNA 'data' matrix from pbmc.so"); m
}
mrna_mat <- get_data_matrix(pbmc.so)
mrna_ct_df <- data.frame(Cell = colnames(pbmc.so), CellType = as.character(SeuratObject::Idents(pbmc.so)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
mrna_ct_df <- dplyr::filter(mrna_ct_df, CellType != "Dendritic cells")
cells_x_mrna <- intersect(mrna_ct_df$Cell[mrna_ct_df$CellType == ct_x], colnames(mrna_mat))
cells_y_mrna <- intersect(mrna_ct_df$Cell[mrna_ct_df$CellType == ct_y], colnames(mrna_mat))
stopifnot(length(cells_x_mrna) > 1, length(cells_y_mrna) > 1)
mrna_detected <- rownames(mrna_mat)[
  rowSums(mrna_mat[, cells_x_mrna, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0 & rowSums(mrna_mat[, cells_y_mrna, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0]
cat(sprintf("SF5 mRNA: %d Mono | %d CD8 | %d detected in both\n", length(cells_x_mrna), length(cells_y_mrna), length(mrna_detected)))

SF5_A_all   <- build_tail_heatmap(intersect(analysis_universe, mrna_detected), "All gene correlations",
                                  strip_fill = celltype_strip_fill, strip_border = celltype_strip_fill, mat = mrna_mat, cells_a = cells_x_mrna, cells_b = cells_y_mrna)
SF5_A_right <- build_tail_heatmap(intersect(right_set, mrna_detected), "Right-tail mRNA correlations",
                                  strip_fill = module_colors[["R1"]], strip_border = module_colors[["R2"]], mat = mrna_mat, cells_a = cells_x_mrna, cells_b = cells_y_mrna)

mrna_cross_cor <- function(genes_left, genes_right, cells) {
  full <- matrix(NA_real_, length(genes_left), length(genes_right), dimnames = list(genes_left, genes_right))
  gl <- intersect(genes_left, mrna_detected); gr <- intersect(genes_right, mrna_detected)
  if (length(gl) >= 1 && length(gr) >= 1) {
    cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(mrna_mat[gl, cells, drop = FALSE]), t(mrna_mat[gr, cells, drop = FALSE]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = inner_cor_method))
    full[gl, gr] <- cc
  }
  full
}
cross_X_mrna <- mrna_cross_cor(left_set, right_set, cells_x_mrna)
cross_Y_mrna <- mrna_cross_cor(left_set, right_set, cells_y_mrna)
cross_df_mrna <- dplyr::bind_rows(melt_cross(cross_X_mrna, ct_x), melt_cross(cross_Y_mrna, ct_y)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(left_protein = factor(left_protein, levels = left_ordered), right_protein = factor(right_protein, levels = right_ordered),
                celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c(ct_x, ct_y)),
                left_cluster = factor(left_cluster[as.character(left_protein)], levels = names(left_strip_labels)),
                right_cluster = factor(right_cluster[as.character(right_protein)], levels = names(right_strip_labels)))
SF5_B <- ggplot(cross_df_mrna, aes(right_protein, left_protein, fill = r)) + geom_tile() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(rows = vars(left_cluster), cols = vars(celltype, right_cluster), scales = "free", space = "free",
    labeller = labeller(left_cluster = left_strip_labels, right_cluster = right_strip_labels, celltype = ggplot2::label_value),
    strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(
      background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = c(celltype_strip_fill, celltype_strip_fill, module_colors[["R1"]], module_colors[["R2"]], module_colors[["R1"]], module_colors[["R2"]])),
      text_x = ggh4x::elem_list_text(size = c(6.6, 6.6, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5), colour = "white", face = "bold", lineheight = 0.9),
      background_y = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(fill = c(module_colors[["L1"]], module_colors[["L2"]])))) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = cor_gradient[["low"]], mid = cor_gradient[["mid"]], high = cor_gradient[["high"]], midpoint = 0,
                       limits = cor_limits, breaks = cor_breaks, labels = cor_labels, oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey85", name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = "Right-tail genes", y = "Left-tail genes") + theme_light(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold", size = 5.5, lineheight = 0.9),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

cat("\n=== Assembling SF5 ===\n")
SF5_A <- wrap_elements(full = (SF5_A_all | SF5_A_right) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1), guides = "collect"))
SF5 <- (SF5_A / SF5_B) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
SF5 <- SF5 & figure_theme
save_figure(SF5, "FigS7", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 150)

cat("\n=== MF3 / SF5 section complete ===\n")
```
