```{r, Script 8}

########################################################################################
## SCRIPT 8 / 8 :
##
## Assumes Script 1 (setup): sc.batch_cor(.ab), pbmc.prot, cell_types_df,
## prot_donor_label, corum_raw, celltype_order/_colors, modality_colors, donor_colors,
## rank_na/fmt_p/spear_annot, save_figure, figure_theme (8 pt), FIG_WIDTH_MM, metadata_dir.
##
##
########################################################################################

# ── Guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local({
  need <- c("sc.batch_cor", "sc.batch_cor.ab", "pbmc.prot", "cell_types_df", "prot_donor_label",
            "corum_raw", "celltype_order", "celltype_colors", "modality_colors", "donor_colors",
            "rank_na", "fmt_p", "spear_annot", "save_figure", "figure_theme", "FIG_WIDTH_MM", "metadata_dir")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(miss))
    stop(sprintf("[MF4] Missing (run Script 1 setup first): %s", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
})

suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(purrr); library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel); library(patchwork)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize); library(ggplotify); library(Seurat); library(fgsea); library(msigdbr)
})
set.seed(42)   

# ── Figure-local constants + theme ───────────────────
carrier_batches <- c("n2p1", "n6p1", "n6p2")
cytokine_color <- "#CE2029"; proteome_color <- "grey70"; rp_color <- "#CE2029"; rp_hl_color <- "#D55E00"
rho_ramp <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D"))
FIG_HEIGHT_MM <- 200
fdr_cov <- 0.10

theme_mf4 <- function() {
  theme_light(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7), axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
          legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), plot.margin = margin(10, 3, 2, 3),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey60"), strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 6),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

prot_meta <- pbmc.prot@meta.data


# ── M0.6 Carrier-cell universe (from setup cell_types_df, which has batch) ───────────
carrier_cells_df <- cell_types_df %>% dplyr::filter(batch %in% carrier_batches, Cell %in% colnames(sc.batch_cor))
carrier_cells <- carrier_cells_df$Cell
cells_by_ct <- lapply(split(carrier_cells_df$Cell, carrier_cells_df$CellType),
                      function(cc) intersect(cc, colnames(sc.batch_cor)))[celltype_order]
cat(sprintf("[M0] Carrier cells: %d | per cell type: %s\n", length(carrier_cells),
            paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(cells_by_ct), lengths(cells_by_ct)), collapse = ", ")))

# ── M0.6b Donor labels (canonical from setup) + verification print ───────────────────
donor_label <- prot_donor_label   # named over colnames(sc.batch_cor): Donor04->Donor 1, Donor05->Donor 2
cat("[M0] Donor label check (raw sample vs assigned label):\n")
print(table(as.character(prot_meta[colnames(sc.batch_cor), "sample"]), donor_label[colnames(sc.batch_cor)]))

# ── M0.7 Cytokine panel (local; read into cyto_anno_df, NOT CytokineSpikeInsFull) ────
cyto_anno_df <- read.csv(file.path(metadata_dir, "cyto_anno.csv"))
cytokine_genes <- cyto_anno_df %>%
  dplyr::select(GENES) %>% tidyr::separate_rows(GENES, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(GENES = trimws(GENES)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("hRANKL|NONE|hCG_2045906", GENES), GENES != "") %>%
  distinct() %>% pull(GENES) %>% setdiff(c("PPBP", "PF4"))
cytokine_genes <- intersect(cytokine_genes, rownames(sc.batch_cor))
cat(sprintf("[M0] Cytokine panel (post PPBP/PF4 drop, in sc.batch_cor): %d genes\n", length(cytokine_genes)))

# ── M0.8 CORUM 40S/60S sets (parsed from setup corum_raw) ────────────────────────────
name_col    <- grep("complex.*name|^complexname$", colnames(corum_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
subunit_col <- grep("subunit.*[Gg]ene.*name", colnames(corum_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
parse_subunits <- function(x) x %>% str_replace_all("\\(.*?\\)", "") %>% str_split(";") %>% unlist() %>% str_trim() %>% setdiff("") %>% unique()
get_rp_set <- function(pattern) {
  rows <- corum_raw %>% dplyr::filter(str_detect(.data[[name_col]], regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  parse_subunits(paste(rows[[subunit_col]], collapse = ";"))
}
rp_40S <- get_rp_set("40S ribosomal subunit"); rp_60S <- get_rp_set("60S ribosomal subunit"); rp_all <- union(rp_40S, rp_60S)
rp_cols <- intersect(c(rp_40S, rp_60S), rownames(sc.batch_cor)); rp_sub <- ifelse(rp_cols %in% rp_40S, "40S", "60S")
cat(sprintf("[M0] CORUM RP: 40S=%d 60S=%d | detected=%d (40S=%d 60S=%d)\n",
            length(rp_40S), length(rp_60S), length(rp_cols), sum(rp_sub == "40S"), sum(rp_sub == "60S")))

# ── M0.9 CORUM complex gene-set list (for CORUM GSEA) ────────────────────────────────
corum_sets <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(corum_raw)), function(i) parse_subunits(corum_raw[[subunit_col]][i])), corum_raw[[name_col]])
corum_sets <- corum_sets[lengths(corum_sets) >= 3]
dup_key <- vapply(corum_sets, function(g) paste(sort(g), collapse = "|"), character(1))
corum_sets <- corum_sets[!duplicated(dup_key)]; names(corum_sets) <- make.unique(names(corum_sets))
cat(sprintf("[M0] CORUM complexes (>=3 subunits, deduped): %d\n", length(corum_sets)))


# ══ M1. Covariation engine — cytokine x proteome (approx Spearman, per cell type) ════
min_cyto_cells <- 100; min_detect_frac <- 0.40; min_coobs <- 100
all_corr_results <- list()
for (ct in celltype_order) {
  M <- sc.batch_cor[, cells_by_ct[[ct]], drop = FALSE]; n_cells <- ncol(M); det <- rowSums(!is.na(M))
  cyto_ct <- intersect(cytokine_genes, rownames(M)); cyto_ct <- cyto_ct[det[cyto_ct] >= min_cyto_cells]
  partner_ct <- setdiff(rownames(M)[det >= min_detect_frac * n_cells], cytokine_genes)
  if (length(cyto_ct) == 0 || length(partner_ct) == 0) { cat(sprintf("[M1] %-12s: skipped\n", ct)); next }
  R_cyto <- t(apply(M[cyto_ct, , drop = FALSE], 1, rank_na)); R_part <- t(apply(M[partner_ct, , drop = FALSE], 1, rank_na))
  Rc <- t(R_cyto); Rp <- t(R_part)
  r_mat <- cor(Rc, Rp, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  coobs_mat <- crossprod(!is.na(Rc), !is.na(Rp)); r_mat[coobs_mat < min_coobs] <- NA
  tval <- r_mat * sqrt((coobs_mat - 2) / (1 - r_mat^2)); p_mat <- 2 * pt(-abs(tval), df = coobs_mat - 2); p_mat[is.na(r_mat)] <- NA
  # BH within each cytokine over TESTED pairs only (n = # non-NA p-values).
  padj_mat <- t(apply(p_mat, 1, function(p) p.adjust(p, method = "BH", n = sum(!is.na(p)))))
  ct_list <- lapply(cyto_ct, function(cy) { keep <- !is.na(r_mat[cy, ])
    data.frame(Gene = partner_ct[keep], r = r_mat[cy, keep], n_coobs = coobs_mat[cy, keep],
               p = p_mat[cy, keep], padj = padj_mat[cy, keep], stringsAsFactors = FALSE) })
  names(ct_list) <- cyto_ct; all_corr_results[[ct]] <- ct_list
  cat(sprintf("[M1] %-12s: %d cells | %d cytokines x %d partners | %s tested pairs\n",
              ct, n_cells, length(cyto_ct), length(partner_ct), format(sum(!is.na(r_mat)), big.mark = ",")))
}


# ══ M2. Whole-proteome negative-covariation diagnostic (printed only) ════════════════
cat("\n[M2] Whole-proteome negative-covariation diagnostic\n")
whole_proteome_summary <- list()
for (ct in celltype_order) {
  tabs <- all_corr_results[[ct]]; if (is.null(tabs)) next
  neg_sums <- vapply(tabs, function(d) sum(d$r[d$r < 0], na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  top_cyto <- names(neg_sums)[which.min(neg_sums)]; d <- tabs[[top_cyto]]
  top10 <- d %>% dplyr::arrange(r) %>% head(10) %>% mutate(is_rp = Gene %in% rp_all)
  whole_proteome_summary[[ct]] <- list(cytokine = top_cyto, neg_sum = neg_sums[[top_cyto]], top10 = top10)
  cat(sprintf("[M2] %-12s | top cytokine = %s (sum_neg_r = %.1f; %d/10 ribosomal)\n",
              ct, top_cyto, neg_sums[[top_cyto]], sum(top10$is_rp)))
}


# ══ M3. GDF6 / B-cell volcano — Panel A ══════════════════════════════════════════════
stopifnot(!is.null(all_corr_results[["B cells"]][["GDF6"]]))
gdf6 <- all_corr_results[["B cells"]][["GDF6"]] %>%
  mutate(is_rp = Gene %in% rp_all, sig = padj < fdr_cov, hl = is_rp & sig,
         neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.eps)))
n_partners <- nrow(gdf6)
cat(sprintf("[M3] GDF6/B cells: %d partners | %d significant RPs\n", n_partners, sum(gdf6$hl)))
gdf6$ct <- "B cells"
lab_A <- gdf6 %>% dplyr::filter(hl) %>% dplyr::arrange(r) %>% head(10)
panel_A <- ggplot(gdf6, aes(r, neg_log10_fdr)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cov), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, !hl), color = proteome_color, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, hl), color = rp_hl_color, alpha = 0.95, size = 1.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab_A, aes(label = Gene), size = 1.8, fontface = "bold", color = rp_hl_color,
                           segment.size = 0.2, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.6, force = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  facet_wrap(~ ct) +
  labs(x = sprintf("GDF6 vs protein\nSpearman r (n = %d)", n_partners), y = expression(-log[10]*"(FDR)")) +
  theme_mf4() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)


# ══ M3b. Donor reproducibility of GDF6 x RP covariation — Panel B ════════════════════
min_coobs_donor <- 30
bcells_carrier <- cells_by_ct[["B cells"]]
bcells_by_donor <- split(bcells_carrier, donor_label[bcells_carrier])[c("Donor 1", "Donor 2")]
stopifnot(all(c("Donor 1", "Donor 2") %in% names(bcells_by_donor)), all(lengths(bcells_by_donor) > 0))
cat(sprintf("[M3b] B cells per donor: D1=%d, D2=%d\n", length(bcells_by_donor[["Donor 1"]]), length(bcells_by_donor[["Donor 2"]])))
gdf6_rp_corr_by_donor <- function(cells) {
  vg <- sc.batch_cor["GDF6", cells]
  vapply(rp_cols, function(g) { v <- sc.batch_cor[g, cells]; ok <- is.finite(vg) & is.finite(v)
    if (sum(ok) < min_coobs_donor) return(NA_real_); suppressWarnings(cor(vg[ok], v[ok], method = "spearman")) }, numeric(1))
}
corr_d1 <- gdf6_rp_corr_by_donor(bcells_by_donor[["Donor 1"]]); corr_d2 <- gdf6_rp_corr_by_donor(bcells_by_donor[["Donor 2"]])
donor_df <- tibble(RP = rp_cols, subunit = rp_sub, d1 = corr_d1, d2 = corr_d2) %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(d1) & is.finite(d2))
cat(sprintf("[M3b] RPs valid in both donors: %d of %d\n", nrow(donor_df), length(rp_cols)))
rng <- range(c(donor_df$d1, donor_df$d2), na.rm = TRUE); donor_df$ct <- "B cells"
panel_B <- ggplot(donor_df, aes(d1, d2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = spear_annot(donor_df$d1, donor_df$d2), hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.0, lineheight = 0.9) +
  coord_equal(xlim = rng, ylim = rng) +
  labs(x = "GDF6\u2013RP Spearman r\n(Donor 1)", y = "GDF6\u2013RP Spearman r\n(Donor 2)") + theme_mf4()


# ══ M4. GSEA on GDF6 r-ranking — Reactome (Panel C) + CORUM (Panel D) ════════════════
ranks_gdf6 <- gdf6 %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(r)) %>% { setNames(.$r, .$Gene) }
ranks_gdf6 <- ranks_gdf6[is.finite(ranks_gdf6)]; ranked_universe <- names(ranks_gdf6)
get_sets <- function(cat, subcat) {
  df <- tryCatch(msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = cat, subcategory = subcat),
                 error = function(e) msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = cat, subcollection = subcat))
  sym <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% names(df)) df$gene_symbol else df$human_gene_symbol; split(sym, df$gs_name)
}
reactome_sets <- get_sets("C2", "CP:REACTOME")
disease_rx <- regex(paste0("DISEASE|DISEASES|DEFECT|DEFECTIVE|ABERRANT|CANCER|CARCINOMA|TUMOR|TUMOUR|ONCOGEN|",
                           "MUTANT|INFECTION|INFECTIOUS|VIRAL|VIRUS|HIV|INFLUENZA|SARS|BACTERIAL|LEISHMANIA|SYNDROME"), ignore_case = TRUE)
reactome_sets <- reactome_sets[!str_detect(names(reactome_sets), disease_rx)]
run_fgsea <- function(sets, ranks) {
  set.seed(42)   # LOCAL — fgsea multilevel is stochastic
  fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(pathways = sets, stats = ranks, minSize = 5, maxSize = 300, eps = 0) %>% as_tibble() %>% dplyr::arrange(padj)
}
gsea_reactome <- run_fgsea(reactome_sets, ranks_gdf6); gsea_corum <- run_fgsea(corum_sets, ranks_gdf6)
gsea_corum <- gsea_corum %>% dplyr::filter(!str_detect(pathway, regex("40S ribosomal subunit, cytoplasmic\\.[0-9]+$", ignore_case = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("[M4] Reactome sig(FDR<10%%): %d | CORUM sig: %d\n",
            sum(gsea_reactome$padj < fdr_cov, na.rm = TRUE), sum(gsea_corum$padj < fdr_cov, na.rm = TRUE)))

reduce_redundant_terms <- function(g_sig, set_list, universe) {
  if (nrow(g_sig) <= 1) return(g_sig)
  paths <- g_sig$pathway; gs <- lapply(paths, function(p) intersect(set_list[[p]], universe)); names(gs) <- paths
  drop <- rep(FALSE, length(paths))
  for (i in seq_along(paths)) for (j in seq_along(paths)) {
    if (i == j) next
    if (length(gs[[j]]) > 0 && length(gs[[j]]) < length(gs[[i]]) && all(gs[[j]] %in% gs[[i]])) { drop[i] <- TRUE; break }
  }
  g_sig[!drop, , drop = FALSE]
}
wrap_label <- function(s, max_words = 8) {
  w <- strsplit(s, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]; if (length(w) <= max_words) return(s)
  mid <- ceiling(length(w) / 2); paste(paste(w[seq_len(mid)], collapse = " "), paste(w[(mid + 1):length(w)], collapse = " "), sep = "\n")
}
prettify <- function(x, db) {
  base <- x %>% str_remove(paste0("^", db, "_")) %>% str_remove("\\.[0-9]+$") %>% str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()
  vapply(base, wrap_label, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
make_nes_barplot <- function(g, set_list, universe, db_prefix, title, top_n = 12) {
  d <- g %>% dplyr::filter(padj < fdr_cov); if (nrow(d) == 0) { cat(sprintf("[M4] %s: none at FDR<10%%\n", title)); return(NULL) }
  d <- reduce_redundant_terms(d, set_list, universe) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(NES))) %>% head(top_n) %>%
    mutate(label = make.unique(prettify(pathway, db_prefix)), label = factor(label, levels = label[order(NES)]), dir = ifelse(NES < 0, "neg", "pos"))
  ggplot(d, aes(NES, label, fill = dir)) + geom_col(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(neg = "#2166AC", pos = "#B2182B"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "NES", y = NULL, title = title) + theme_mf4() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, lineheight = 0.8), plot.title = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}
panel_C <- make_nes_barplot(gsea_reactome, reactome_sets, ranked_universe, "REACTOME", "Reactome pathways, <10% FDR")
panel_D <- make_nes_barplot(gsea_corum, corum_sets, ranked_universe, "", "CORUM complexes, <10% FDR")
if (is.null(panel_C)) panel_C <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
if (is.null(panel_D)) panel_D <- patchwork::plot_spacer()


# ══ M5. Cytokine x 40S/60S RP heatmap — Panel E ══════════════════════════════════════
select_rp_cytokines <- function(ct, n_top = 5) {
  tabs <- all_corr_results[[ct]]; if (is.null(tabs)) return(NULL)
  scored <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tabs), function(cy) {
    d <- tabs[[cy]] %>% dplyr::filter(Gene %in% rp_all)
    data.frame(Cytokine = cy, n_signeg_rp = sum(d$padj < fdr_cov & d$r < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
               sum_neg_r_rp = sum(d$r[d$r < 0], na.rm = TRUE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) }))
  if (nrow(scored) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (sum(scored$n_signeg_rp > 0) >= n_top)
    scored %>% dplyr::filter(n_signeg_rp > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_signeg_rp), sum_neg_r_rp) %>% head(n_top) %>% mutate(selection = "sig_count")
  else scored %>% dplyr::arrange(sum_neg_r_rp) %>% head(n_top) %>% mutate(selection = "neg_sum_fallback")
}
sel <- bind_rows(lapply(celltype_order, function(ct) { s <- select_rp_cytokines(ct); if (is.null(s) || nrow(s) == 0) return(NULL); cbind(CellType = ct, s) }))
present_cts <- celltype_order[celltype_order %in% sel$CellType]; sel$CellType <- factor(sel$CellType, levels = present_cts)
cat("[M5] Rows selected per cell type:\n"); print(sel %>% dplyr::count(CellType, selection))

row_keys <- paste(sel$CellType, sel$Cytokine, sep = "||")
mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(sel), length(rp_cols), dimnames = list(row_keys, rp_cols))
sig_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow(sel), length(rp_cols), dimnames = list(row_keys, rp_cols))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sel))) {
  d <- all_corr_results[[as.character(sel$CellType[i])]][[sel$Cytokine[i]]]; idx <- match(rp_cols, d$Gene)
  mat[i, ] <- d$r[idx]; padj_i <- d$padj[idx]; sig_mat[i, ] <- !is.na(padj_i) & padj_i < fdr_cov
}
stopifnot("B cells" %in% present_cts)
b_block <- mat[row_keys[sel$CellType == "B cells"], , drop = FALSE]; b_block[is.na(b_block)] <- 0
order_subunit_by_bcell <- function(sub) {
  cs <- rp_cols[rp_sub == sub]; if (length(cs) < 2) return(cs)
  hc <- stats::hclust(stats::dist(t(b_block[, cs, drop = FALSE]), method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2"); cs[hc$order]
}
col_order <- c(order_subunit_by_bcell("40S"), order_subunit_by_bcell("60S"))
mat <- mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]; sig_mat <- sig_mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]; rp_sub_ordered <- rp_sub[match(col_order, rp_cols)]
corr_dist <- function(m) { if (nrow(m) < 2) return(stats::as.dist(matrix(0, nrow(m), nrow(m))))
  cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(t(m), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")); cc[!is.finite(cc)] <- 0; stats::as.dist(1 - cc) }
left_anno <- rowAnnotation(CellType = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = celltype_colors[present_cts], col = NA), width = unit(2.5, "mm")), show_annotation_name = FALSE)
ht <- Heatmap(mat, name = "Spearman r", col = rho_ramp, na_col = "grey85", row_split = sel$CellType, cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_rows = corr_dist, clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", show_row_dend = FALSE,
  row_title = present_cts, row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "bold"), row_title_rot = 0,
  row_labels = sel$Cytokine, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5), row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"), left_annotation = left_anno,
  column_split = factor(rp_sub_ordered, levels = c("40S", "60S")), column_title = c("40S ribosome", "60S ribosome"),
  cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_column_slices = FALSE, show_column_dend = FALSE, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4), column_names_rot = 90, column_gap = unit(2, "mm"), border = TRUE, rect_gp = gpar(col = NA),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) { if (sig_mat[i, j]) grid::grid.text("*", x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 5, col = "black")) },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), labels = c("\u2264 -0.5", "0", "\u2265 0.5"), title = "Spearman r",
                              legend_height = unit(15, "mm"), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), grid_width = unit(2.5, "mm")))
panel_E <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(grid::grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", merge_legend = TRUE)))


# ══ M6. Ribosomal PC1 state axis (B cells) — Panels F & G ════════════════════════════
stopifnot("GDF6" %in% rownames(sc.batch_cor))
bcells <- cells_by_ct[["B cells"]]; axis_rps <- gdf6$Gene[gdf6$is_rp]; stopifnot(length(axis_rps) >= 3)
Mb <- sc.batch_cor[axis_rps, bcells, drop = FALSE]; Xc <- t(Mb)
Cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(Xc, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")); coobs_rp <- crossprod(!is.na(Xc)); Cmat[coobs_rp < 75] <- NA
Cmat0 <- Cmat; Cmat0[is.na(Cmat0)] <- 0; diag(Cmat0) <- 1
eig <- eigen(Cmat0, symmetric = TRUE); v1 <- eig$vectors[, 1]; names(v1) <- rownames(Cmat0); if (mean(v1) < 0) v1 <- -v1
pc1_var <- eig$values[1] / sum(eig$values)
cat(sprintf("[M6] Axis RPs: %d | PC1 variance: %.1f%%\n", length(axis_rps), 100 * pc1_var))
rp_mean <- rowMeans(Mb, na.rm = TRUE); rp_sd <- apply(Mb, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE); rp_sd[rp_sd == 0 | is.na(rp_sd)] <- NA
Z <- (Mb - rp_mean) / rp_sd; ZL <- Z * v1[rownames(Z)]; pc1_score <- colSums(ZL, na.rm = TRUE)
coverage <- colSums(!is.na(Z)) / nrow(Z); pc1_score[coverage < 0.40] <- NA
tc_genes <- setdiff(intersect(gdf6$Gene, rownames(sc.batch_cor.ab)), axis_rps)
tc_block <- sc.batch_cor.ab[tc_genes, bcells, drop = FALSE]
total_content <- log2(colSums(2 ^ tc_block, na.rm = TRUE))
tc_ndet      <- colSums(!is.na(tc_block))
cat(sprintf("[M6] Content summed over %d proteins (axis RPs excluded: %d) | linear-scale CV = %.1f%%\n",
            length(tc_genes), length(axis_rps),
            100 * sd(2 ^ total_content, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(2 ^ total_content, na.rm = TRUE)))
fgh <- data.frame(cell = bcells, gdf6 = sc.batch_cor["GDF6", bcells], pc1 = pc1_score[bcells], tc = total_content[bcells], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
fit_idx <- with(fgh, is.finite(pc1) & is.finite(tc)); fit_G <- lm(pc1 ~ tc, data = fgh[fit_idx, ])
cat(sprintf("[M6] Panel G: PC1 ~ content adj R2 = %.3f | n = %d\n", summary(fit_G)$adj.r.squared, sum(fit_idx)))
local({
  ok <- with(fgh, is.finite(pc1) & is.finite(tc))
  nd <- tc_ndet[fgh$cell]
  s1 <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(fgh$pc1[ok], nd[ok], method = "spearman"))
  s2 <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(fgh$tc[ok],  nd[ok], method = "spearman"))
  s3 <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(fgh$pc1[ok], fgh$tc[ok], method = "spearman"))
  cat(sprintf("[M6] PC1 vs content        : rho = %6.3f | p = %s | n = %d\n",
              unname(s3$estimate), fmt_p(s3$p.value), sum(ok)))
  cat(sprintf("[M6] PC1 vs # proteins det : rho = %6.3f | p = %s\n",
              unname(s1$estimate), fmt_p(s1$p.value)))
  cat(sprintf("[M6] content vs # prot det : rho = %6.3f | p = %s  (should be low)\n",
              unname(s2$estimate), fmt_p(s2$p.value)))
})

fgh_F <- fgh[is.finite(fgh$gdf6) & is.finite(fgh$pc1), ]; fgh_F$ct <- "B cells"
panel_F <- ggplot(fgh_F, aes(gdf6, pc1)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = spear_annot(fgh_F$gdf6, fgh_F$pc1), hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.0, lineheight = 0.9) +
  labs(x = expression(atop("GDF6, relative log"[2]*" abundance")), y = "Ribosomal PC1 score") + theme_mf4() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
fgh_G <- fgh[fit_idx, ]; fgh_G$ct <- "B cells"
panel_G <- ggplot(fgh_G, aes(tc, pc1)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = spear_annot(fgh_G$tc, fgh_G$pc1), hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.0, lineheight = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Total protein content per cell", y = "Ribosomal PC1 score") + theme_mf4() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)


# ══ M7. FIGURE ASSEMBLY — MF4 (uses setup figure_theme, 8 pt) ════════════════════════
cat("\n=== Assembling MF4 ===\n")
tag_A <- panel_A + labs(tag = "A"); tag_B <- panel_E + labs(tag = "B"); tag_C <- panel_B + labs(tag = "C")
tag_D <- panel_F + labs(tag = "D"); tag_E <- panel_G + labs(tag = "E"); tag_F <- panel_C + labs(tag = "F")
nes_corum <- panel_D

row1 <- (tag_A | tag_B) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.8, 2.4))
row2 <- (tag_C | tag_D | tag_E) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))
row3 <- (tag_F | nes_corum) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))
row1 <- row1 & figure_theme; row2 <- row2 & figure_theme; row3 <- row3 & figure_theme

MF4 <- (wrap_elements(full = row1) / wrap_elements(full = row2) / wrap_elements(full = row3)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.5, 1, 1.15))
save_figure(MF4, "Fig4", FIG_WIDTH_MM, FIG_HEIGHT_MM)
cat("[M7] MF4 assembled and written.\n")
cat("\n=== MF4 section complete ===\n")

```
